homepage.home.001.message: Apache Doris：面向 AI 时代的开源实时分析与检索数据库
homepage.home.001.description: Apache Doris: Open Source, Real-Time Analytics and Search Database for the AI Era

homepage.home.002.message: Apache Doris 是基于 MPP 架构的开源实时分析数据库，使用一个引擎即可在 PB 级数据上执行 OLAP 查询、湖仓分析与混合检索。
homepage.home.002.description: Apache Doris is an open-source, real-time analytics database built on MPP architecture. Run OLAP queries, lakehouse analytics, and hybrid search at petabyte scale on a single engine.

marketing.compare.100.message: Doris 和 Elasticsearch 都服务于可观测性、安全和实时分析。Doris 在存储成本、写入效率与分析深度上更有优势，同时无需使用专有 DSL。
marketing.compare.100.description: Doris and Elasticsearch both serve observability, security, and real-time analytics. Doris pulls ahead on storage cost, write efficiency, and analytical depth, all without a custom DSL.

marketing.compare.103.message: Doris 对日志和指标数据的压缩比为 1:5 至 1:10，Elasticsearch 则为 1:1.5，相同数据所需的磁盘空间更少。
marketing.compare.103.description: Doris compresses logs and metrics at 1:5 to 1:10, versus Elasticsearch's 1:1.5. The same data fits on a fraction of the disk.

marketing.compare.105.message: 高写入吞吐，低资源开销。

marketing.compare.106.message: Doris 在多个副本间只构建一次索引，开销低于 10%。Elasticsearch 则为每个副本分别构建索引，在去重场景下写入开销最高达到 3 倍。
marketing.compare.106.description: Doris indexes once across multiple replicas, keeping overhead under 10%. Elasticsearch indexes each replica separately and pays up to 3× per write under deduplication.

marketing.compare.108.message: 全文检索结合 SQL，无需 DSL。
marketing.compare.108.description: Full-text search and SQL, no DSL.

marketing.compare.109.message: 生产迁移案例表明，全文检索速度达到原来的 2–3 倍，同时获得多表关联、物化视图和开放 MySQL 生态的能力。
marketing.compare.109.description: Production migrations report 2–3× faster full-text search, with multi-table joins, materialized views, and the open MySQL ecosystem on top.

marketing.compare.110.message: 来自可观测性、金融安全与物流行业的 Elasticsearch 到 Doris 真实迁移：相同工作负载，更低的成本。
marketing.compare.110.description: Real Elasticsearch-to-Doris migrations across observability, financial security, and logistics. Same workload, dramatically smaller bill.

marketing.compare.112.message: 观测云以 Apache Doris 替换 Elasticsearch 后，在数据处理速度和成本优化方面取得了明显进展。
marketing.compare.112.description: By replacing Elasticsearch with Apache Doris, GuanceDB took a big stride in improving data processing speed and reducing costs.

marketing.compare.176.message: Doris 与 Trino/Presto 都是主流湖仓查询引擎。Doris 将数据仓库与湖仓查询统一到一个引擎，在两类场景下都能更快地执行相同 SQL。
marketing.compare.176.description: Doris and Trino/Presto are both mainstream lakehouse query engines. Doris unifies the data warehouse and the lakehouse query engine, running the same SQL dramatically faster across both.

marketing.compare.178.message: 全向量化 C++ 引擎。

marketing.compare.179.message: Doris 的内部表查询速度最高为 Presto/Trino 的 10 倍。全向量化 C++ 引擎可直接处理数仓工作负载，而 Trino 需要将这类任务交给下游系统。
marketing.compare.179.description: Doris runs internal-table queries up to 10× faster than Presto/Trino. The fully vectorized C++ engine handles the warehouse workloads that Trino has to defer to a downstream system.

marketing.compare.181.message: 更好地加速外部表查询。

marketing.compare.182.description: Doris executes lakehouse queries 2–3× faster than Presto/Trino, measured on the TPC-DS 1TB benchmark with both engines querying the same external Hive tables.

marketing.compare.184.message: 面向实时分析，不止于交互查询。

marketing.compare.185.message: 专为高并发实时分析设计，可支持数千并发查询，超越 Trino 所针对的交互式工作负载。
marketing.compare.185.description: Built for high-concurrency real-time analytics with thousands of concurrent queries, well beyond the interactive-only workloads Trino targets.

marketing.compare.186.message: 网络、游戏和物流行业从 Trino/Presto 迁移至 Doris 的真实案例：相同 SQL，更简单的架构，更快的查询。
marketing.compare.186.description: Real Trino/Presto-to-Doris migrations across networking, gaming, and logistics. Same SQL, simpler architecture, faster queries.

marketing.compare.188.message: 引入 Apache Doris 替换多套技术栈后，我们构建了统一湖仓，显著提升查询性能与系统稳定性，资源成本降低了 30%。
marketing.compare.188.description: By introducing Apache Doris to replace several technology stacks, we achieved a unified lakehouse, significantly improved query performance and system stability, and reduced resource costs by 30%.

marketing.compare.004.message: Apache Doris 与其他方案：选型指南
marketing.compare.004.description: Apache Doris vs. the Others — Selection Guide

marketing.compare.005.message: 为业务选择合适的实时分析数据库。从架构、性能和总体成本出发，对比 Apache Doris、ClickHouse、Elasticsearch 与 Trino/Presto。
marketing.compare.005.description: Pick the right real-time analytical database for your workload. See how Apache Doris compares with ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and Trino/Presto on architecture, performance, and total cost.

marketing.compare.006.message: Doris 和 ClickHouse 都是主流实时分析数据库。对于现代数据团队的日常工作负载，Doris 在多方面更有优势。
marketing.compare.006.description: Doris and ClickHouse are both leading real-time analytical databases. Doris pulls ahead on the workloads modern data teams run every day.

marketing.compare.008.message: 分布式多表关联，无需通过宽表规避关联操作。
marketing.compare.008.description: Distributed multi-table joins, no wide-table workarounds.

marketing.compare.009.message: MPP 架构结合基于代价的优化器，自动选择 Broadcast、Shuffle 或 Colocate Join。Doris 可完成全部 TPC-DS 查询，ClickHouse 则有约 50% 的查询无法完成。
marketing.compare.009.description: MPP architecture with a cost-based optimizer that automatically picks Broadcast, Shuffle, or Colocate joins. Doris completes the full TPC-DS suite; ClickHouse fails about 50% of the queries.

marketing.compare.012.message: 计算资源弹性扩展，无需数据重均衡。开源 3.0 及以上版本即提供该成本模型，无需绑定商业云服务。
marketing.compare.012.description: Elastic compute scales without rebalancing. The cost model ships with open-source 3.0+, with no commercial-cloud lock-in.

marketing.compare.014.message: 支持实时 UPSERT，同时保持查询速度。
marketing.compare.014.description: Real-time UPSERTs without sacrificing query speed.

marketing.compare.015.message: 写时合并在高频更新下保持稳定的读取性能。支持完整 ACID 和 MySQL 协议，并发查询可达数千，而非不足 100。
marketing.compare.015.description: Merge-on-Write keeps reads stable under high-frequency updates. Full ACID, MySQL-compatible, with thousands of concurrent queries instead of fewer than 100.

marketing.compare.016.message: 互联网规模企业的真实生产迁移：相同的 SQL 工作负载，不同的运行结果。
marketing.compare.016.description: Real production migrations at internet-scale companies running the same SQL workloads, with very different outcomes.

marketing.observability.047.message: 现代可观测性平台需要具备五项关键能力，Apache Doris 提供相应支持。
marketing.observability.047.description: Five things a modern observability platform has to be good at, and the specific Apache Doris capabilities that meet each one.

marketing.observability.048.description: Ingest Every Signal in Real Time

marketing.observability.049.message: 可观测性数据来自应用、Kubernetes、API、网关、数据库和 AI 系统。平台需要低延迟接入大量日志、链路、指标和 AI Agent 事件，让大模型请求、工具调用、RAG 检索、Token 成本、评估和用户反馈都能近实时查询。
marketing.observability.049.description: Observability data streams in from applications, Kubernetes, APIs, gateways, databases, and AI systems. The platform has to absorb high-volume logs, traces, metrics, and AI agent events with low latency, so every signal, from LLM requests and tool calls to RAG retrievals, token costs, evaluations, and user feedback, is ready to query in near real time.

marketing.observability.050.message: 无需复杂 ETL，即可分析动态 JSON
marketing.observability.050.description: Analyze Dynamic JSON Without Heavy ETL

marketing.observability.051.message: 日志、链路、工具输出、模型回答和 Agent 事件常以嵌套 JSON 形式到达，字段持续变化。平台需要适应 Schema 演进，让新字段立即可查询，支持团队过滤、排查和分析新信号，无需重建数据链路。
marketing.observability.051.description: Logs, traces, tool outputs, model responses, and agent events often arrive as nested JSON whose fields keep changing. The platform must handle schema evolution and make any new field queryable at once, so teams can filter, investigate, and analyze new signals without rebuilding pipelines.

marketing.observability.052.message: 快速全文检索日志与 Agent 信号
marketing.observability.052.description: Fast Full-Text Search Across Logs & Agent Signals

marketing.observability.053.message: 可观测性数据不仅包括错误消息、调用栈和日志行，也包括提示词、模型回答、工具输出与 Agent 失败原因。团队需要快速的关键词与全文检索能力，大规模定位故障、追踪请求并分析 Agent 行为。
marketing.observability.053.description: Observability data is full of searchable text: error messages, stack traces, and log lines, but also prompts, model responses, tool outputs, and agent failure reasons. Teams need fast keyword and full-text search to find failures, trace requests, and investigate agent behavior at scale.

marketing.observability.054.message: 交互分析指标、成本与质量
marketing.observability.054.description: Interactive Analytics on Metrics, Cost & Quality

marketing.observability.055.message: 可观测性不止于检索。团队需要对大型遥测数据集切片、聚合和下钻，分析 P99 延迟与 SLA 趋势、Token 使用量、模型成本、RAG 质量及 Agent 任务完成情况。这需要兼具快速检索能力的高性能分析引擎。
marketing.observability.055.description: Observability is not only search. Teams slice, aggregate, and drill into large telemetry datasets to analyze reliability, cost, and AI quality: P99 latency and SLA trends, token usage, model cost, RAG quality, and agent task completion. That takes a high-performance analytical engine next to fast search.

marketing.observability.056.message: 面向 AI Agent 可观测性的混合检索
marketing.observability.056.description: Hybrid Search for AI Agent Observability

marketing.observability.057.message: AI Agent 可观测性不只需要日志关键词检索。团队将结构化元数据与提示词、回答、工具调用、链路的全文及语义检索关联，在一条查询中查找精确匹配、相似故障、幻觉输出和重复的 Agent 行为。
marketing.observability.057.description: AI agent observability needs more than keyword search over logs. Teams correlate structured metadata with full-text and semantic search across prompts, responses, tool calls, and traces, so one query can find exact matches, similar failures, hallucinated outputs, and recurring agent behavior.

marketing.ai.003.description: Apache Doris is a high-performance analytical foundation for AI applications, RAG systems, and AI observability: real-time analytics, hybrid search, and AI-native SQL in one engine.

marketing.ai.007.description: Apache Doris gives AI applications real-time access to trusted, queryable enterprise data. Build data-aware agents, improve RAG quality, monitor AI behavior, and run analytics and hybrid search across structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data at scale.

marketing.ai.026.message: AI 就绪分析需要什么，

marketing.ai.028.message: AI 就绪分析平台需要具备五项关键能力，Apache Doris 提供相应支持。
marketing.ai.028.description: Five things an AI-ready analytics platform has to do well, and the specific Apache Doris capabilities that meet each one.

marketing.ai.029.message: AI 应用的端到端低延迟
marketing.ai.029.description: End-to-End Low Latency for AI Applications

marketing.ai.030.message: AI 应用和自主 Agent 基于新鲜数据实时行动。新事件、CDC 更新和流式数据需要在数秒内可查询，即使面对高并发生产流量，分析查询也需要在 1 秒内返回。
marketing.ai.030.description: AI applications and autonomous agents act on fresh data in real time. New events, CDC updates, and streaming data must become queryable within seconds, and analytical queries must return in sub-second time, even under high-concurrency production traffic.

marketing.ai.031.message: 结构化、文本与向量数据的混合检索
marketing.ai.031.description: Hybrid Search Across Structured, Text & Vector Data

marketing.ai.032.message: AI 应用需要检索文档、日志、提示词、回答、反馈、知识库、工单和嵌入向量。SQL、关键词检索与向量检索各有侧重；AI 就绪分析将结构化过滤、全文检索、语义相似性与相关性排序统一到一个工作流。
marketing.ai.032.description: AI applications search across documents, logs, prompts, responses, feedback, knowledge bases, support tickets, and embeddings. SQL, keyword search, and vector search each solve part of the problem. AI-ready analytics combines structured filters, full-text search, semantic similarity, and relevance-aware ranking in one workflow.

marketing.ai.033.message: 适应 AI 原生数据的灵活 Schema

marketing.ai.034.message: AI 原生应用会持续产生来自模型、Agent、工具、框架和工作流的半结构化事件。平台需要处理动态 JSON、嵌套字段、Schema 演进、快速过滤与即席 SQL，减少复杂 ETL，让团队直接分析 Agent 每一步、工具调用、检索事件和模型回答。
marketing.ai.034.description: AI-native applications emit constantly changing, semi-structured events from models, agents, tools, frameworks, and workflows. The platform must handle dynamic JSON, nested fields, schema evolution, fast filtering, and ad hoc SQL without heavy ETL, so teams can analyze every agent step, tool call, retrieval event, and model response directly.

marketing.ai.035.message: AI 可观测性数据分析

marketing.ai.036.message: AI 可观测性不止于日志、指标与链路。团队需要在同一位置分析模型调用、提示词、回答、工具执行、检索事件、Token 使用量、延迟、成本、评估分数和用户反馈。服务层需要灵活的 Schema、快速检索与交互式聚合，以处理大量 AI 原生数据。
marketing.ai.036.description: AI observability goes beyond logs, metrics, and traces. Teams analyze model calls, prompts, responses, tool executions, retrieval events, token usage, latency, cost, evaluation scores, and user feedback in one place. The serving layer must handle flexible schemas, fast search, and interactive aggregation over large volumes of AI-native data.

marketing.ai.038.message: AI 应用依赖快速演进的 Agent 框架、LLMOps 平台、可观测性工具、MCP 工作流与自定义数据链路。平台需要融入该生态，让 Agent、Copilot、RAG 系统和 LLMOps 工具通过 SQL、API、连接器及 MCP 读取可信数据、写入 AI 信号。
marketing.ai.038.description: AI applications rely on a fast-changing ecosystem of agent frameworks, LLMOps platforms, observability tools, MCP workflows, and custom pipelines. The platform must plug into that ecosystem so agents, copilots, RAG systems, and LLMOps tools can read trusted data and write AI signals through SQL, APIs, connectors, and MCP.

marketing.figures.093.message: Apache Doris 为 AI 提供分析底座：文档、向量嵌入和流式数据持续更新 Doris；AI 应用提出问题，Doris 用一次混合查询融合 SQL 过滤、全文检索和向量检索，LLM 生成回答，再将链路、Token、成本和反馈写回 Doris，改进下一轮交互。
marketing.figures.093.description: AI-ready analytics on Apache Doris: documents, embeddings, and streams keep Doris fresh; an AI application asks a question, Doris answers with one hybrid query that fuses SQL filters, full-text search, and vector search, the LLM generates a response, and its traces, tokens, cost, and feedback are logged back into Doris to improve the next round.

marketing.figures.094.description: FIG. 04 · THE AGENT LOOP: ASK → RETRIEVE → GENERATE → LOG → IMPROVE, ALL ON ONE ENGINE

marketing.features.cards.key-features-an.message: Doris 的 SQL 窗口函数支持跨行排名、累加、偏移和求平均；优化器可将 Top-N 过滤下推至窗口算子。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-ba.message: 通过 LOAD LABEL 或 INSERT INTO SELECT，从 S3、HDFS 和外部 Catalog 异步批量导入数据，并基于 Label 去重。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-bm.message: Apache Doris 通过 BM25 相关性对全文检索结果排序，使 SQL 查询能像搜索引擎一样排列匹配结果。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-ca.message: 连接 Glue、Iceberg REST、HMS、S3 Tables、Polaris、Unity、DLF 等 Catalog，用一个引擎访问多种湖仓元数据服务。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-ch.message: Doris 表将向下游消费者提供的行级变更数据流。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-co.message: Doris 的磁盘 Segment 格式通过按列编码、按 Page 压缩降低存储占用，并利用 Page 级索引跳过无需读取的数据页。
在存算分离架构下，将共享对象存储的无状态 BE 划分为独立资源池，新增查询组无需复制数据。
以位向量缓存 Segment 级过滤计算结果，让包含相同 WHERE 条件的查询复用谓词计算。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-da.message: 湖仓读取的两级缓存：本地磁盘缓存远端文件字节，内存缓存解压后的列数据页。
后台合并让 Doris 在高频导入下保持性能，并为通用 OLAP 和仅追加的时序工作负载提供对应策略。
从 Nereids 执行计划中提取列级血缘，通过可插拔 SPI 发送至治理工具，并在审计日志中提供表级访问记录。
Duplicate、Unique、Aggregate 三种表模型决定数据行的存储、去重和排序方式，建表时确定。
在分区、Tablet、Segment 和 Page 等层级跳过无关数据，尽量减少查询读取量。
支持 SQL UPDATE、条件 DELETE、部分列更新和原子分区替换，基于 Unique Key 表的写时合并机制实现。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-em.message: EMBED() SQL 函数调用外部模型，将文本和多媒体转换为 ARRAY<FLOAT> 向量，用于向量检索。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-fu.message: 直接在 SQL 中执行全文查询，支持分词感知的运算符，能力超越 LIKE 子串匹配。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-gr.message: 在服务端将多个小批量 INSERT 和 Stream Load 合并为一个事务，通过同步和异步模式平衡延迟与吞吐量。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-hi.message: 通过短路查询路径将 Unique Key 表用作低延迟 KV 存储，主键等值查询可支撑数万 QPS。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-hy.message: 在同一张表的一次 SQL 查询中融合全文匹配与向量相似度，无需维护独立搜索集群。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-ic.message: 完整的 Apache Iceberg 引擎，通过七种 Catalog 后端读写 Iceberg 表，支持 V2/V3 删除、分支、标签和时间旅行。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-in.message: 分区异步物化视图在 REFRESH AUTO 模式下只重建基表数据发生变化的分区，保持看板数据新鲜。
将各类列上的等值、范围、IN、IS NULL 和文本谓词从全表扫描转为倒排列表查找。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-ka.message: 通过 Routine Load 直接拉取 Kafka Topic，或通过 Flink 传输 MySQL/PostgreSQL CDC，利用 Stream Load 2PC 实现精确一次写入。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-ll.message: AI_* SQL 函数将列值发送至 LLM 并直接返回结果，在 SQL 中完成分类、信息提取和摘要生成。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-lo.message: 将多条导入语句作为一个原子单元执行，支持基于 Label 去重，并通过 2PC 实现流式写入的精确一次语义。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-ma.message: 通过 SQL 写入和管理 Iceberg、Hive 与 Paimon 表，涵盖 CREATE、INSERT、UPDATE、DELETE、Schema 与分区演进、分支和快照。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-mc.message: Doris MCP Server 1.0 通过八个工具领域、55 项能力，为 Claude Desktop、Cursor 等 MCP 客户端提供 Apache Doris 集群的只读访问。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-me.message: 对外部 Catalog 的表列表、Schema、分区、文件列表和 Iceberg Manifest 进行多级缓存，使查询规划保持毫秒级。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-mp.message: 将一个 SQL 查询转换为 Fragment 实例的 DAG，在 Shared-Nothing 集群的多个 BE 上并行执行。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-mu.message: 通过三段式名称，在同一个 Doris 集群中对内部数仓及 Hive、Iceberg、JDBC、ES 等外部系统进行联邦查询。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-pa.message: 原生 C++ 向量化 Parquet 读取器支持 Row Group 和 Page 裁剪、直接字典解码，以及过滤后延迟读取数据。
两级数据分片机制：分区按列拆分表以支持裁剪，分桶将各分区拆分为 Tablet 以支持并行读取。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-pi.message: 基于推送模型和任务窃取的调度器，将查询拆解为算子流水线 DAG，在 BE 的固定线程池中执行。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-pl.message: 无需修改 FE 代码，即可通过配置选择 LDAP、Kerberos、OIDC 或 Ranger，并组合认证链实现回退。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-pr.message: Aggregate Key 表在导入时聚合数据行，ROLLUP 提供预计算的候选索引，由优化器透明选择。
通过 MySQL 协议支持服务端预处理语句，按会话缓存解析计划，降低重复查询的 FE CPU 开销。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-qu.message: 在 Pipeline 层按 Tablet 粒度缓存中间聚合结果，让访问相同 Tablet 的查询复用计算。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-re.message: 使用 ROW_NUMBER 和标准 1/(k+rank) 公式，在 SQL 中融合 BM25 与向量排名，无需内置 RRF 函数。
按 BE 节点标签将集群划分为物理隔离的资源池，使离线 ETL 组与在线查询组互不影响。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-sp.message: 内存密集型算子达到限制时将中间状态写入本地磁盘，使大型 Join、聚合和排序能继续执行，避免内存溢出。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-st.message: 通过同步 HTTP PUT 导入 CSV、JSON、Parquet 和 ORC，支持 Label 去重和批次级原子提交。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-un.message: Doris 的主键表模型，每个主键保留一行，支持 SQL UPDATE/DELETE、部分列更新及处理乱序写入的 Sequence 列。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-va.message: 无需固定 Schema 即可摄取 JSON，并将高频路径存为原生列式子列，提供列存级分析性能。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-ve.message: 在 ARRAY<FLOAT> 列上构建原生 ANN 索引，在 Doris 表内执行毫秒级 TopN 向量检索，与 SQL 分析协同使用。
以列批次和 SIMD 为基础的执行引擎；自 v2.0 移除最后的行式代码路径后，所有算子均在该引擎上运行。
按列组执行数据合并，控制 Doris 合并宽表 Rowset 时的内存占用。

marketing.features.cards.key-features-wo.message: 在进程内按查询组分配 CPU、内存、IO 和并发资源，防止重型 ETL 挤占 BI 看板资源。
