landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.message: 本周 48 位贡献者合并 144 个 PR，工程内核持续占据主导，存算分离与实时数仓紧随其后，显示 Doris 正稳步向更弹性的云原生架构和更强的实时处理能力演进。湖仓格式互通、全文检索提速与企业级安全治理同步推进，安全治理与 Agent 可观测性等新兴方向的加速布局，也预示着平台正从核心性能优化向更广泛的企业级与智能化场景扩展。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.description: This week 48 contributors merged 144 PRs, with kernel engineering remaining the dominant focus, closely followed by compute-storage separation and real-time data warehouse work—signaling Doris's steady march toward a more elastic cloud-native architecture and stronger real-time processing. Progress on lakehouse format interoperability, full-text search acceleration, and enterprise security governance advanced in parallel, while emerging momentum in security governance and agent observability points to the platform's expansion beyond core performance into broader enterprise and intelligent-application scenarios.

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.message: 湖仓格式互通:原生 Variant、Fluss 接入与 Iceberg REST 规划
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.description: Lakehouse Interop: Native Variant, Fluss Access, Iceberg REST Planning

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.message: Doris 加速 Parquet 未分片 Variant 路径提取,支持将 Variant 按 Parquet 原生 VARIANT 类型导入导出,避免 JSON 编解码开销并保持跨引擎可识别;新增 Fluss catalog 可读日志表、主键表及湖仓一体表;并推进 Iceberg REST 服务端扫描规划,让 Doris 成为多格式湖仓的统一查询入口。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.description: Doris speeds up unshredded Parquet Variant extraction and adds native Parquet VARIANT export/import, avoiding JSON re-encoding while staying cross-engine readable. A new Fluss catalog reads log, primary-key, and lakehouse-tiered tables; Iceberg REST server-side scan planning advances toward unified multi-format lakehouse access.

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.message: 企业级安全治理:账户锁定、双密码轮换、代理鉴权与全链路 TLS
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.description: Enterprise Security: Account Locking, Dual-Password Rotation, Proxy Auth & End-to-End TLS

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.message: Doris 补齐 MySQL 兼容的持久化账户锁定与双密码轮换,支持无停机凭证更换;新增 SU...WITH ROLES 代理鉴权,让网关类中间层以最终用户身份执行查询并审计;内部通信全面对齐 TLS,并按用户身份限制 AI 资源创建,面向多租户与合规场景补齐治理短板。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.description: Doris adds durable MySQL-compatible account locking and dual-password rotation for zero-downtime credential changes, plus SU...WITH ROLES proxy auth so gateway tiers run queries as the actual end user with proper audit. Internal paths now honor TLS end-to-end, and AI resource creation is restricted by identity—closing governance gaps for multi-tenant, compliance-driven

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.message: 全文检索提速:短语下推、近似 LIKE/REGEXP 索引与按段扫描
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.description: Full-Text Search Acceleration: Phrase Pushdown, Approximate LIKE/REGEXP Index, Segment-Aligned Scans

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.message: 倒排索引支持可配置 ngram 差值、短语查询下推候选行位图、按 segment 对齐扫描分片,大幅减少无效 posting 遍历;新增基于 gram 索引的近似 LIKE/REGEXP 下推,以及 index_disk_usage 表函数透视索引存储构成,让日志与文本检索场景兼顾速度与可观测性。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.description: Inverted-index search gets configurable ngram sizing, candidate-bitmap pushdown into phrase queries, and segment-aligned scan splitting to cut redundant posting walks. A new approximate gram index accelerates LIKE/REGEXP pruning, while index_disk_usage exposes index storage composition—sharpening speed and observability for log and text search workloads.

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.message: 云原生存算分离:IO 合并预读、对象存储落盘与原生 Azure 接入
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.description: Cloud-Native Elasticity: I/O Coalescing/Read-Ahead, Object-Storage Spill, Native Azure Access

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.message: Doris 引入 PageIO 预读、跨 range IO 合并与缓存块补洞,降低存算分离下的远程 IO 依赖;云模式支持落盘至 S3 对象存储并计入 SHOW DATA 计费;原生 Azure 凭证接入摆脱 AWS 兼容层;结合 tablet 活跃度统计优化,共同提升弹性伸缩效率与成本可控性。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.description: Doris adds PageIO read-ahead, cross-range I/O coalescing, and cache-block hole-filling to cut remote I/O dependencies in compute-storage separation. Cloud mode can now spill to S3 object storage with billing visibility in SHOW DATA, plus native Azure credential support beyond the AWS-shim—together sharpening elasticity and cost control.

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.message: 行级 Binlog 与 CDC 管道成熟:TTL 回收、TSO 裁剪与稳定列映射
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.description: Row Binlog & CDC Maturity: TTL Retention, TSO Pruning, Stable Column Mapping

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.message: Doris 为 ROW Binlog 引入行级/时间窗 TTL 与基于 TSO 的 rowset 前置裁剪,降低增量查询初始化开销;FE 下发稳定列映射解耦读写路径对物理布局的依赖;CDC 同步作业支持正则表匹配与表注释同步,以及 S3 一次性流式导入,持续打磨实时数仓链路的可靠性与易用性。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.summar.description: Doris adds row/window TTL for ROW Binlog with TSO-based rowset pruning ahead of scans, cutting initialization cost for bounded incremental queries. FE-computed stable column mappings decouple read/write from physical layout, while CDC jobs gain regex table matching, comment sync, and one-time S3 ingestion—maturing the real-time pipeline end to end.

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 多模湖仓
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Multi-modal Lakehouse

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 湖仓联邦查询的正确性在 Iceberg、Paimon、Hive 上全面提升：Iceberg 修复了模式演进后的等值删除、name mapping 校验、缺失文件处理与 identity 分区保留；Paimon 修正了 schema 与时间戳精度问题；Hive CSV 表解析对齐 OpenCSVSerde 语义，减少了跨外部 Catalog 的静默数据错误与查询结果不一致。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Lakehouse federation correctness improved across Iceberg, Paimon, and Hive: schema-evolution-aware equality deletes, safer name-mapping validation, missing-file handling, and identity-partition preservation for Iceberg; schema/timestamp precision fixes for Paimon; and OpenCSVSerde-compatible parsing for Hive CSV tables, reducing silent data corruption and inconsistent query results across external catalogs.

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 多模湖仓方向修复了 Iceberg 在 Azure 上的原生凭证路由，以及 Iceberg/Parquet 浮点 NaN 与旧版时间戳统计信息导致的谓词下推误裁剪问题（新提交），避免因元数据统计不准确而漏读数据，同时也包含 AI 资源相关问题修复，提升湖仓联邦查询的正确性。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Multi-modal lakehouse work fixes native Azure credential routing for Iceberg files, plus newly opened fixes for Iceberg/Parquet predicate pushdown mis-pruning matching rows due to NaN handling and legacy timestamp statistics—preventing silent data loss from inaccurate metadata—alongside AI resource-related fixes, improving federated lakehouse query correctness.

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 实时数仓
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Real-time Data Warehouse

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 实时数仓在规划与执行层面获得提速：Eager Aggregation 引入基于统计信息的贪心 Join 重排以找到更优下推位置，通过延迟 SQL Cache 渲染和精简 Cascades 代价计算降低了 Planner 开销，Partial Update 冲突读取按更新模式在行存/列存间智能选择，物化视图改写正确补偿了失效的汇总分区。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Real-time analytics got faster planning: eager aggregation now uses statistics-based greedy join reordering for better pushdown positions, planner overhead was cut by deferring SQL-cache rendering and pruning redundant Cascades cost work, partial-update conflict resolution picks row- vs column-store reads by update mode, and MV rewrite correctly compensates invalidated roll-up partitions.

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 实时数仓方向多项关键优化推进中：高并发点查支持 RPC 微批合并显著提升吞吐（highlight），MTMV 缓存改用全局 LRU 管理以解决大规模物化视图导致的 FE 堆内存膨胀，向量化可空比较谓词提升 SIMD 效率，以及 HBO 结构信息等（均为 key 级重点）。本周还新增标记连接谓词下推、自适应随机分桶路由等修复，持续增强流批一体的性能与稳定性。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Real-time warehouse work advances several key efforts: RPC micro-batching for high-concurrency point queries (highlight) boosts throughput, MTMV cache moves to a global LRU manager to curb FE heap bloat from large-scale materialized views, nullable comparison predicates gain SIMD vectorization, and HBO struct-info work continues (all key-level). New fixes this week

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 存算分离/云原生
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Compute-Storage Separation & Cloud-Native

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 存算分离本周在写入与缓存链路上提升了效率与正确性：删除位图清理改为按点删除以降低 FDB 压力，文件缓存的淘汰统计与 TTL 处理被修正，事务提交/版本缓存及 binlog TSO 追踪在重试与主备切换场景下更加健壮，预热任务在 FE 重启后能正确恢复目标锁。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Compute-storage separation work improved efficiency and correctness in write and cache paths: delete-bitmap removal switched to point deletes to ease FDB pressure, file-cache eviction/TTL accounting was corrected, commit/version caches and binlog TSO tracking were hardened against retries and failover, and warm-up jobs now recover cleanly after FE restarts.

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 存算分离方向本周集中修复元数据一致性与竞态问题：新增 V2 delete bitmap 一致性校验、打包文件（packed file）回收校验重构，以及针对计算组属性同步、compute group 重建映射、commit 分区校验、过期事务下 delete bitmap 重读、compaction 聚合覆盖新数据等多个竞态/一致性缺陷的修复，多数为本周新提交，整体提升元数据服务与 BE 之间数据正确性的健壮性。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Compute-storage separation work this week focuses on metadata consistency and race conditions: new V2 delete bitmap consistency checks, a refactored packed-file recycling checker, plus fixes for compute-group property sync, group-recreation mapping, stale commit/rowset races, delete-bitmap reads across expired transactions, and compaction overwriting newer bitmaps—most opened this week, hardening correctness between

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: Agent 可观测性
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Agent Observability

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: Variant V2 存储引擎本周成为默认路径，修复了嵌套 element_at 链的子列路径下推问题；倒排索引写入器不再遗留空的孤儿索引文件，新增跳过 norms 的索引属性可显著减小宽 Variant 表的索引体积；ngram 搜索函数增加了对非法参数的前置校验。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Variant V2 storage is now the default engine, with sub-column path pruning fixed for nested element_at chains. Inverted-index writers stop leaving orphan empty index files, and a new norms-skipping option shrinks index size for wide Variant schemas; ngram search now validates its parameters upfront.

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 本周核心进展是为 Variant 类型打通关系运算：引入统一的规范比较器，使 FE/BE 在等值判断上保持一致，支持 Variant 表达式间的 `=`、`!=`、`<=>` 比较（含与 NULL 比较）而无需显式 CAST，并启用 Variant 哈希连接（含半连接/反连接、mark join 及 IN/NOT IN 子查询），为半结构化数据分析提供更自然的 SQL 语义。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: This week's key advance connects Variant values to relational operations: a shared canonical comparator aligns FE/BE equality semantics, enabling `=`, `!=`, `<=>` comparisons between Variant expressions (including against NULL) without explicit CAST, and unlocking Variant hash joins—semi/anti, mark joins, and IN/NOT IN subqueries—for more natural semi-structured SQL.

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 生态集成
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Ecosystem Integration

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 跨引擎与驱动连接能力持续完善：Trino 联邦查询避免了类型转换后的错误谓词下推，JDBC Catalog 正确解析 SQL Server 别名类型，binlog 的 compaction 策略与 DELETE 事件处理得到修复。尤为重要的是，Arrow Flight SQL 首次原生支持会话级 SET/GET 操作，使 ADBC 客户端无需 SQL 语句即可管理 catalog、database 与会话变量。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Cross-engine connectivity improved: Trino federation avoids invalid predicate pushdown after type casts, JDBC catalogs correctly resolve SQL Server alias types, and binlog compaction/DELETE handling was fixed for downstream consumers. Notably, Arrow Flight SQL now serves session-level SET/GET actions, letting ADBC clients manage catalog, schema, and variables without raw SQL.

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 生态兼容性方面本周新增多项协议与连接器修复：JDBC catalog 尊重用户指定字符编码、MySQL 结果集字段长度与预处理语句参数类型转发的正确性、Arrow Flight SQL 时区标签可移植性，以及 CDC streaming job 错误报告与手动恢复能力增强、Oracle BINARY_FLOAT/DOUBLE 类型支持，持续打磨 Doris 与外部客户端、数据源的互操作体验。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Ecosystem compatibility saw several new fixes this week: JDBC catalogs now honor user-specified character encoding, MySQL result-set field lengths and prepared-statement parameter forwarding are corrected, Arrow Flight SQL timezone labels are made portable, CDC streaming jobs gain better error reporting and manual recovery, and Oracle BINARY_FLOAT/DOUBLE mapping is added—broadening interoperability

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 安全治理
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Security & Governance

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 多处权限缺口被修复：行级权限策略在 leading Hint 重排 Join 与 MOW 时间旅行查询下不再被绕过，binlog 表函数强制要求 SELECT 权限，审计脱敏不再泄露 SET_VAR 会话状态，CDC 操作以任务创建者身份而非硬编码 admin 执行，JDBC/Iceberg/Paimon Catalog 的 driver_url 安全校验实现统一。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Access-control gaps were closed: row policies now hold under leading-hint join rebuilds and MOW time-travel queries, binlog table functions require SELECT privilege, audit redaction no longer leaks SET_VAR session state, CDC operations run under job creator's identity, and JDBC driver-URL validation is unified across JDBC, Iceberg, and Paimon catalogs.

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 安全治理方面本周新增修复字典与表在同一数据库内因共享权限命名空间而产生的同名冲突问题，此前两者互不检查可导致权限键歧义；此外还有字典加载标识符转义防注入及预处理点查询短路复用的授权上下文校验，持续收紧对象命名与权限边界的一致性保障。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Security governance adds a new fix this week rejecting name collisions between tables and dictionaries in the same database—since they share a privilege namespace but previously weren't cross-checked, risking ambiguous privilege keys—alongside identifier quoting to prevent injection in dictionary loads and stricter authorization-context guards for reused prepared point-query plans.

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 内核基础工程
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Kernel & Engineering

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 内核工程本周完成了大量正确性与性能加固：涵盖优化器（UNION、TopN 下推、聚合改写）、标量函数（日期、字符串、IP、Decimal 转换）、Zone Map、窗口函数与 Compaction 的多项修复，并推进 BE Java 插件隔离、Key Range Compaction 扩展以及移除遗留的 minidump 与原生文件格式代码等重构。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Kernel engineering delivered broad correctness and performance hardening: fixes across the optimizer (union, TopN pushdown, aggregate rewrites), scalar functions (date, string, IP, decimal casts), zonemaps, window functions, and compaction, plus refactors isolating BE Java plugins, extending key-range compaction, and removing legacy minidump/native-file-format code.

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 内核工程本周体量最大，亮点是新增原生 UUID 数据类型，贯穿 FE/BE/存储/表达式全链路。其余是大批本周新提交的正确性修复，覆盖表达式化简（除法、CASE、NULL 语义）、TopN 懒物化、隐藏列（TSO/VERSION）读取一致性、ARM64 兼容性、JSONB/IPv6/时间戳边界处理及查询取消资源泄漏，持续夯实执行与优化器的正确性与稳定性。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Kernel engineering is the largest group, highlighted by a native UUID data type spanning FE/BE/storage/expressions. Most remaining items, largely opened this week, are correctness fixes across arithmetic simplification, CASE/NULL semantics, TopN lazy materialization, hidden-column (TSO/VERSION) read consistency, ARM64 compatibility, JSONB/IPv6/timestamp edge cases, and query-cancellation resource leaks—steadily hardening the execution engine

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 多模湖仓
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Multi-modal Lakehouse

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 社区希望Doris完整支持Iceberg REST服务端扫描规划（server-side scan planning）。当前虽已升级Iceberg Java SDK，但Doris在处理RESTTable时将其降级为普通BaseTable，丢失了服务端规划能力并绕过了不支持模式的保护机制。该需求旨在让Doris通过SDK正确获取执行计划并执行服务端返回的任务，提升与Iceberg REST Catalog的兼容性和查询效率。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: The community wants Doris to fully support Iceberg REST server-side scan planning. Currently, despite adopting a newer Iceberg Java SDK, Doris downgrades RESTTable into a plain BaseTable, losing planning behavior and bypassing safeguards for unsupported modes. This work aims to properly retrieve plans via the SDK and execute server-returned tasks, improving Iceberg REST Catalog compatibility and efficiency.

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 实时数仓
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Real-time Data Warehouse

landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..message: 针对ROW Binlog长期无限保留导致存储压力和维护困难的问题，社区提出为其引入基于TTL的保留与垃圾回收机制。该方案覆盖查询可见性控制、过期数据的后台发现、compaction以及最终文件回收，并需同时适配shared-nothing和存算分离（云）两种部署形态，以更好支撑增量查询、表流和物化视图增量维护场景。
landing.reports.2026-09-14.report.repos..description: Since ROW Binlog is retained indefinitely, creating storage and maintenance burdens, the community proposes a TTL-based retention and garbage collection policy. This end-to-end design covers query visibility, background discovery of expired data, compaction, and file reclamation across both shared-nothing and cloud-native deployments, better supporting incremental queries, table streams, and materialized view maintenance.

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.message: Doris 本周继续向更完整的湖仓读写、更灵活的半结构化数据分析，以及面向资源受限和高并发场景的查询能力推进；44 位贡献者推动合并了 97 个 PR，社区新增 11 个 issue。内核与工程仍是活动重心，实时数仓紧随其后，整体方向是夯实执行基础，同时拓宽湖仓互操作与在线查询服务能力。
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.description: This week, Doris continued toward more complete lakehouse reads and writes, more flexible semi-structured analytics, and broader query capabilities for resource-constrained and highly concurrent workloads; 44 contributors helped merge 97 PRs, while the community opened 11 new issues. Kernel and engineering remained the main focus, followed by real-time warehousing, pointing to stronger execution foundations alongside broader lakehouse interoperability and online query serving.

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.message: Paimon 写入链路走向完整
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.description: Toward a Complete Paimon Write Path

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.message: 该提案将完整 Paimon 写入链路移植至主干，涵盖原生分桶路由、JNI 写入和提交载荷传输，并升级至 Paimon 1.4.2，推动 Doris 从湖上查询向读写一体演进。
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.description: The proposal forward-ports the complete Paimon write path to master, including native bucket routing, JNI writing, and commit payload transport, while upgrading to Paimon 1.4.2. It moves Doris toward integrated lakehouse reads and writes.

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.message: Fluss 统一湖数据与变更日志读取
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.description: Unified Lake and Changelog Reads with Fluss

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.message: 拟新增的 Fluss Catalog 支持日志表、主键表和分层表，将快照与后续变更按键合并，或在一次扫描中读取 Paimon 湖数据及后续日志，为统一分析历史与最新数据拓展路径。
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.description: The proposed Fluss catalog supports log, primary-key, and tiered tables. It merges snapshots with subsequent changes by key or scans Paimon lake data alongside later logs, extending Doris toward unified analysis of historical and recent data.

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.message: VARIANT 接入原生关系运算
该提案以共享规范比较器衔接 VARIANT 比较与哈希连接，支持无需显式转换的相等性比较及多类连接、子查询，让半结构化数据更直接地参与 SQL 关联分析。
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.description: The proposal connects VARIANT comparisons and hash joins through a shared canonical comparator, enabling equality comparisons without explicit casts and supporting multiple join and subquery forms. It makes semi-structured values more directly usable in relational SQL analysis.

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.message: 查询溢写拓展至窗口计算与对象存储
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.description: Query Spill Expands to Windows and Object Storage

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.message: 这些提案为符合条件的非流式窗口函数增加溢写，并允许云模式选择 S3 溢写、通过 SHOW DATA 查看占用，旨在缓解大分区内存压力，拓展本地磁盘之外的临时存储选择。
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.description: The proposals add spill for eligible non-streaming window functions and selectable S3 spill in cloud mode, with storage usage visible through SHOW DATA. They aim to ease memory pressure from large partitions and extend temporary storage options beyond local disks.

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.message: 批量点查拓展高并发服务能力
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.description: Batched Point Lookups for Concurrent Serving

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.message: 这些提案提供可选 RPC 微批处理与批量行存点查，分别合并同一 BE 的并发请求、按 tablet 分组符合条件的字面量 IN 查询键，旨在减少调度和扫描开销，推动 Doris 承载更多高并发查询服务。
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.summar.description: The proposals introduce optional RPC micro-batching and batch row-store lookups, combining concurrent requests to the same BE and grouping eligible literal IN lookup keys by tablet. They aim to reduce scheduling and scanning overhead, extending Doris toward high-concurrency query serving.

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..message: 面向同时使用 AI 与湖表的分析，本周让嵌入模型可独立配置端点、凭据和模型，未配置时沿用通用设置；Iceberg 嵌套小数也支持保持标度的精度扩展，提升服务配置灵活性与模式演进兼容性。
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..description: For analytics combining AI and lake tables, embedding models gain independent endpoint, credential and model settings, with fallback to general AI configuration. Iceberg nested decimals now accept precision widening at unchanged scale, improving service configuration flexibility and schema-evolution compatibility.

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..message: 湖仓查询正将分区筛选前移至 Hive Metastore，避免高分区数表的全量枚举。本周新开的 Hive/Hudi 分区值下推进一步尝试仅凭元数据回答分区列查询，免开数据文件；Oracle 浮点类型映射则补充跨源兼容性。
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..description: Lakehouse work pushes selective partition filtering into Hive Metastore to avoid full listings on heavily partitioned tables. Newly opened Hive/Hudi partition-value pushdown would answer partition-column queries without opening data files, extending metadata-driven execution. Oracle floating-point mappings also broaden cross-source compatibility.

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..message: 实时数仓本周重点减少数值 DISTINCT 合并中的哈希集合复制和中间状态开销，并降低 VARIANT 数组导入 CPU 消耗。增量读取与云端 INSERT 重试修复提升数据处理可靠性，流任务测试更稳定，空间分析新增 ST_Within。
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..description: Real-time warehouse work centers on cheaper numeric DISTINCT merging, removing hash-set copies and intermediate-state overhead. Lower VARIANT array ingestion CPU complements fixes to incremental reads and cloud INSERT retries, improving processing reliability. Streaming tests become more stable, while ST_Within extends spatial analysis.

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..message: 实时数仓工作正通过行与 binlog TTL、一次性 S3 导入控制数据生命周期，并以可选分桶哈希和约束推导 colocate join 减少数据搬运；gamma 扩展数学分析。本周新开的聚合状态终结与批量合并旨在减少重复聚合，SQL 计划管理也已启动，导入调度和基数估算继续改进。
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..description: Retention and ingestion work centers on row/binlog TTL and one-time S3 imports. Configurable bucketing and constraint-inferred colocated joins target data movement; gamma extends analytics. Newly opened aggregate-state finalization and batch merging target redundant aggregation, alongside new SQL plan management, load scheduling, and cardinality-estimation work.

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..message: 存算分离读取正朝适配访问模式的方向推进：通过预读、I/O 合并和缓存块补洞，减少点查过量下载及顺序扫描的远程等待。同时，活跃 tablet 统计拟改用 BE 报告，降低 FE 内存占用，并为云端均衡提供更可靠的活动依据。
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..description: Cloud reads are moving toward access-aware read-ahead, I/O coalescing, and cache-block hole filling to reduce excessive point-query downloads and sequential-scan remote waits. BE-reported tablet activity would also replace FE tracking windows, reducing frontend memory use and providing more reliable activity inputs for cloud balancing.

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..message: 搜索工作正聚焦联表谓词的正确求值和字段级分析器选择，并缩减稀疏 VARIANT 索引、按字段统计 BM25 文档数，以改善检索正确性、相关性和存储效率。模糊匹配扩展相似度分析；本周新开的解析改进拟让函数决定 JSON 错误行为，消除可变 BE 配置的影响。
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..description: Search work targets correct join predicates and field-specific analyzers, while smaller sparse VARIANT indexes and per-field BM25 document counts aim to improve retrieval correctness, relevance, and storage efficiency. Fuzzy matching broadens similarity analysis. Newly opened parsing work makes JSON error behavior function-defined rather than dependent on mutable BE settings.

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..message: Hive 迁移工作正补齐字符集转换语义，通过兼容的 encode/decode 减少 SQL 改写。字符集参数限定为受支持的字符串字面量或 NULL，使 Doris 能在查询执行前确定转换路径，支持向量化处理。
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..description: Hive migration work targets missing character-conversion semantics through compatible encode/decode functions, reducing SQL rewrites. Restricting charset arguments to supported string literals or NULL lets Doris select the conversion path before execution and support vectorized processing.

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..message: 本周内核工程围绕生产负载的正确性与稳定性，收紧优化器和类型转换语义，修复崩溃、陈旧数据及权限匹配问题，并完善物化视图恢复、连接生命周期和缓存管理，降低扫描开销与运维风险。
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..description: This week’s kernel work strengthens correctness and stability under production workloads. Safer optimizer and conversion semantics address wrong results, while fixes tackle crashes, stale data and policy matching. Better materialized-view recovery, session lifecycles and cache management reduce operational risk alongside scan overhead.

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..message: 内核工作以共享异步范围读取基础设施和原生 128 位 UUID 为重点，旨在改善远程 I/O 与标识符存储。更广泛的加固覆盖查询正确性和资源控制；本周新开的工作进一步针对崩溃、内存核算、缓存与元数据生命周期及诊断缺口。
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..description: Shared asynchronous range-read infrastructure and native 128-bit UUID support anchor work on remote I/O efficiency and identifier storage. Broader hardening targets query correctness and resource control; newly opened efforts address crashes, memory accounting, cache and metadata lifecycles, and diagnostic gaps to make execution and operations more dependable.

landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..message: 社区希望 Doris 的 Lance 向量检索支持批量独立查询，每个查询分别返回 Top-K，并通过查询索引标识结果归属。这让用户能在一次批量请求中获取各查询的排名结果，区别于多向量合成一个逻辑查询或并发执行多条 SQL。
landing.reports.2026-09-21.report.repos..description: The community wants Doris’s Lance vector retrieval to batch independent queries, each returning its own Top-K with a query index identifying result ownership. Users could retrieve separate rankings in one batch, distinct from combining vectors into one logical query or running concurrent SQL statements.

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.message: Doris 本周的进展指向更紧密的实时数仓与湖数据读写融合，同时继续以强劲的内核工程投入提升查询效率和原生数据能力；社区共有 37 位贡献者参与，合并 79 个 PR，新增 21 个 issue。Paimon 写入基础与 Fluss 统一读取体现了这一融合方向，点查开销优化、文本搜索与中文分析增强，以及原生 UUID 类型支持，则推动数仓能力进一步完善。
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.description: This week’s progress points Doris toward tighter integration of real-time warehousing with lake data reads and writes, while sustained kernel engineering strengthens query efficiency and native data capabilities; community activity included 37 contributors, 79 merged PRs, and 21 new issues. Foundations for Paimon writes and unified Fluss reads illustrate that integration direction, while lower point-query overhead, improvements to text search and Chinese analysis, and native UUID support further develop its warehouse capabilities.

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.message: 面向 Paimon 写入的通用连接器基础
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.description: A Shared Foundation for Paimon Writes

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.message: 已合并的通用写入框架覆盖 118 个文件，支持连接器定义分发、变更日志式行级 DML 和提交报告。Paimon 实现仍待合并，方向是让湖仓从外表查询走向可扩展的写入与更新。
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.description: The merged write framework spans 118 files, enabling connector-defined distribution, changelog-based row-level DML, and commit reports. The Paimon implementation remains open, pointing toward extensible lakehouse writes and updates alongside external-table queries.

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.message: 统一读取 Fluss 日志、快照与湖数据
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.description: Unified Reads Across Fluss Logs, Snapshots, and Lake Data

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.message: 已合并的 Fluss catalog 覆盖 186 个文件，支持日志读取、按键合并快照与后续日志，以及一次扫描读取 Paimon 湖数据和后续日志，让数仓查询统一访问不同存储形态的数据。
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.description: The merged Fluss catalog spans 186 files, supporting log reads, key-based merging of snapshots with subsequent logs, and single-scan access to Paimon lake data plus subsequent logs. This gives warehouse queries unified access across these storage forms.

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.message: 点查扩展性：减少扫描、通信与内存开销
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.description: Scaling Point Queries with Less Overhead

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.message: 三项尚待合并的改进提出跨 tablet 索引剪枝、可选 RPC 微批处理和减少查找缓存预分配，针对 tablet 数量与连接并发增长带来的开销，为大规模实时点查提供优化方向。
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.description: Three open proposals target cross-tablet index pruning, optional RPC micro-batching, and reduced lookup-cache preallocation. Together, they address overhead as tablet counts and concurrent connections grow, outlining a path toward more scalable real-time point lookups.

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.message: 索引文本搜索提速，中文分析更灵活
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.description: More Efficient Text Search, More Flexible Chinese Analysis

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.message: 已合并的改进通过近似 gram 索引筛选并复核 LIKE/REGEXP 候选行，将候选位图下推至短语查询，并允许 IK 分词器组合自定义过滤器，让数仓兼顾精确文本匹配、日志搜索效率与中文分析灵活性。
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.description: Merged changes add approximate gram pruning with exact rechecks for LIKE/REGEXP, push candidate bitmaps into phrase queries, and let IK tokenizers compose with custom filters. Together, they advance warehouse text search through preserved matching accuracy, more efficient log queries, and flexible Chinese analysis.

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.message: UUID 成为原生数仓类型
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.description: UUID Becomes a Native Warehouse Type

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.message: 原生 128 位 UUID 支持已合并，覆盖 441 个文件，贯穿 SQL、存储、序列化和外部桥接。固定宽度表示为字符串存储提供替代方案，使 UUID 标识符在数仓各层获得一致的类型支持。
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.summar.description: Merged native 128-bit UUID support spans 441 files across SQL, storage, serialization, and external bridges. A fixed-width representation provides an alternative to string storage, establishing consistent type support for UUID identifiers throughout the warehouse.

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..message: 本周新开的多模湖仓工作着眼串行 AI 请求、三维地理数据损坏和 Delta 访问限制，推进可配置并发、Z/M 支持及实验性原生 Delta 目录；结合分区元数据优化和新开的 Iceberg 空值约束展示修正，旨在改善分析效率与互操作性。
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..description: New proposals address serial AI requests, 3D geospatial corruption, and Delta access limitations through configurable concurrency, Z/M support, and an experimental native Delta catalog. Together with partition-metadata optimizations and newly proposed Iceberg nullability display corrections, this work aims to improve analytical efficiency and interoperability.

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..message: 实时数仓工作着力让持续摄取和增量计算更可靠：持久化顺序与取消处理修复减少任务停滞和资源滞留，按物化视图分区跟踪刷新基线细化失效管理；ROW binlog 开关校验和 CDC 子进程隔离强化运行保障，Fluss 连接与缓存复用减少重复扫描开销。
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..description: Real-time warehouse work improves ingestion durability and cancellation responsiveness, reducing stalled jobs and delayed resource release. Partition-level materialized-view baselines refine invalidation handling, while ROW binlog gating and CDC subprocess isolation strengthen operational safeguards. Fluss connection pooling and shared reader caches reduce repeated scan overhead.

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..message: 实时数仓工作以 ROW Binlog TTL 控制日志保留，通过一次性 S3 导入和分区级基数估算改善导入生命周期与规划。本周新开工作进一步关注 CDC 模式变更恢复、导入关闭阻塞、物化视图变更影响及覆盖写取消后的可靠结果。
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..description: Real-time warehouse work emphasizes ROW Binlog TTL for retention, one-time S3 ingestion, and partition-aware cardinality estimates. Newly opened proposals extend this reliability focus to CDC schema-change recovery, load-close starvation, materialized-view schema-change impact, and dependable outcomes when INSERT OVERWRITE is cancelled.

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..message: 存算分离工作正减少对本地磁盘和长期密钥的依赖：通过 GKE Workload Identity 为 GCS 提供无密钥认证，并支持向 S3 存储库溢写、在 SHOW DATA 展示占用，旨在缓解本地容量限制并提供计费可见性。
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..description: Cloud-native work aims to reduce dependence on local disks and long-lived keys. GKE Workload Identity would enable keyless GCS access, while S3 vault spill would relieve local capacity constraints and expose stored spill size through SHOW DATA for billing visibility.

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..message: 生态集成正以 Hive 兼容的字符编解码降低迁移成本，同时完善 Flight SQL 元数据及过滤语义、对齐 Trino 时长格式，旨在减少现有 SQL 和客户端接入 Doris 时的行为差异。
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..description: Integration work centers on Hive-compatible character encoding and decoding to ease workload migration. More reliable Flight SQL metadata and filtering, alongside Trino-compatible duration formatting, aim to reduce behavioral differences when existing SQL and clients move to Doris.

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..message: 本周统一了 /rest/v1 的访问校验：非云模式下，HTTP Basic 请求也须通过与 Cookie 请求相同的 ADMIN_OR_NODE 检查。登录接口仅负责身份认证，新 Web UI 随后通过 /rest/v1/ui/me 检查 ADMIN 权限；逾期检查仍仅适用于云模式。
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..description: REST access checks now consistently require ADMIN_OR_NODE for both HTTP Basic and cookie requests, including outside cloud mode. Login only authenticates, with the new Web UI checking ADMIN through /rest/v1/ui/me afterward. Overdue checks remain cloud-only.

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..message: 治理工作正将数据过期与云身份管理纳入原生能力：建表时配置的行级 TTL 控制过期数据可见性；本周新开的 GCP IAM 支持则希望统一 FE、BE 和 Cloud 的 OAuth 认证，减少对 HMAC 密钥的依赖。
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..description: Governance work brings expiration and cloud identity into native workflows. Row-level TTL configured at table creation would control expired-row visibility, while newly opened GCP IAM support aims to unify OAuth authentication across FE, BE, and Cloud, reducing dependence on HMAC keys.

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..message: 本周内核工作聚焦查询正确性与运行稳定性：统一函数和湖仓读写的边界语义，减少漏行、错误结果及崩溃；修复扫描并发受限和存储重试问题，并加强权限校验与依赖安全，让复杂分析更可靠。
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..description: This week’s kernel work strengthens query correctness and operational stability by aligning edge-case semantics across functions and lakehouse reads and writes, reducing missing rows, incorrect results, and crashes. Fixes also restore adaptive scan concurrency and storage retries, while tighter privilege checks and dependency updates strengthen security.

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..message: 内核工作聚焦资源控制与诊断：窗口溢写缓解内存压力，共享导入调度优先推进提交，索引空间明细辅助调优。本周新开的线程池扫描默认化、FE 原生内存约束及查询标识日志工作，进一步着眼运行稳定性和故障定位。
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..description: Kernel work targets resource control and diagnosis: window spill addresses memory pressure, shared load scheduling prioritizes commits, and index space breakdowns guide tuning. Newly opened work proposes default thread-pool scanning, bounded FE native memory growth, and query IDs in logs to improve operational stability and troubleshooting.

landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..message: 社区希望 Doris 的多模湖仓查询更可复现、响应更快：让向量与全文搜索选择 Lance 快照，支持历史或分支对比；通过资源级并发控制减少 AI 批次串行等待；同步预热索引到 BE 本地共享缓存，减少查询时的随机 S3 读取。
landing.reports.2026-09-28.report.repos..description: The community wants reproducible, faster multimodal lakehouse queries. Selectable Lance snapshots would enable historical or branch comparisons in vector and full-text search, while resource-controlled AI batch concurrency would reduce sequential waits. Synchronous index prewarming into BE-local shared caches would reduce random S3 reads during queries.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.message: 本周，Apache Doris 的能力演进指向更完整的湖仓读写、更大查询的承载能力，以及云端摄取与身份认证的完善，同时推动半结构化数据融入关系查询。内核与工程仍是社区活动的重心，实时数仓紧随其后，湖仓与云原生能力也持续推进。39 位贡献者参与，社区合并了 76 个 PR，并新增 38 个 Issue，体现出持续的开发与反馈活跃度。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.description: This week, Apache Doris is moving toward more complete lakehouse reads and writes, greater capacity for large queries, and stronger cloud ingestion and identity authentication, while bringing semi-structured data into relational queries. Kernel and engineering remain the center of community activity, followed by real-time data warehousing, with lakehouse and cloud-native capabilities also advancing. With 39 contributors participating, 76 PRs merged, and 38 new issues opened, the community shows sustained development and feedback activity.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.message: Paimon 读写能力走向完整
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.description: Toward Complete Paimon Read and Write Support

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.message: Paimon 表写入已合入，覆盖 232 个文件的大规模实现拓展了 Doris 的湖仓写入能力。拟议的 Rust 读取路径通过 Arrow 对接 BE，默认关闭并检查节点能力。两者推动 Paimon 集成从查询走向读写协同。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.description: Paimon table writes landed in a substantial implementation spanning 232 files, expanding Doris’s lakehouse write capabilities. A proposed Rust reader connects to BE through Arrow, remains disabled by default, and checks backend capabilities. Together, these changes move Paimon integration toward coordinated reads and writes.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.message: 为大查询拓展溢写空间
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.description: Expanding Spill Capacity for Larger Queries

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.message: 两项拟议改动为符合条件的非流式窗口函数增加溢写，并让云模式查询使用 S3 存储库承接溢写数据。这有望缓解大分区的内存压力和本地磁盘限制，推动弹性查询执行；SHOW DATA 提供尽力而为的溢写占用统计。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.description: Proposed changes add spill for eligible non-streaming windows and let cloud queries spill to S3 storage vaults. This could ease large-partition memory pressure and local-disk constraints, advancing elastic query execution. SHOW DATA would expose best-effort spill occupancy.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.message: S3 摄取兼顾批次完成与事件发现
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.description: S3 Ingestion Gains Completion and Event Discovery

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.message: 已合入的一次性 S3 摄取在最终批次提交后自动完成，改动覆盖 14 个文件。拟议的 SQS 通知发现可捕获键名落在已提交游标之前的新文件。这让对象存储摄取朝着明确完成边界和更可靠的持续发现发展。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.description: One-time S3 ingestion landed across 14 files, finishing automatically after the final batch commits. Proposed SQS notification discovery would capture new files whose keys precede the committed cursor. This moves object-storage ingestion toward explicit completion boundaries and more reliable continuous discovery.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.message: 覆盖 100 个文件的已合入改动，将 Variant 的规范相等语义与比较及哈希连接贯通，支持无需 CAST 的相等比较和更多连接形式。这减少了半结构化数据关联查询的转换负担，推动灵活数据类型融入常规 SQL 分析。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.description: A merged change spanning 100 files connects Variant’s canonical equality semantics to comparisons and hash joins, enabling equality comparisons without casts and broader join forms. This reduces conversion overhead when correlating semi-structured data and brings flexible data types further into everyday SQL analytics.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.message: GCS 访问迈向原生身份认证
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.description: Toward Native Identity Authentication for GCS

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.message: 拟议改动通过 GKE 工作负载身份、默认凭据或 Compute Engine 服务账号，为存储库及更广泛的 GCS 操作引入 OAuth 认证，并支持可选账号模拟。这有望减少长期 HMAC 密钥依赖，让数据仓库访问更贴合 GCP 身份治理。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.summar.description: Proposed changes introduce OAuth authentication through GKE Workload Identity, default credentials, or Compute Engine service accounts for vaults and broader GCS operations, with optional service-account impersonation. This could reduce reliance on long-lived HMAC keys and align warehouse access more closely with GCP identity governance.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 多模湖仓
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Multi-modal Lakehouse

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 湖仓数据跨连接器、JDBC、文件读取和外部写入流转时，需要保留原始类型语义。本周统一完善二进制、UUID 和时间戳映射，相关二进制字段以 VARBINARY 暴露，保留无效 UTF-8、内嵌 NUL 和尾部零字节，文件 TVF 的嵌套字段也适用，减少数据转换失真。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Lakehouse data needs consistent semantics across connectors, JDBC, file readers, and external writes. This week strengthened binary, UUID, and timestamp mappings. Affected binary fields now expose VARBINARY and preserve invalid UTF-8, embedded NULs, and trailing zeros, including nested fields in file TVFs, reducing conversion-related data distortion.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 湖仓工作正通过元数据裁剪、分区值读取和扫描调度减少无效文件访问及热点。本周新开重点包括 AI 请求连接复用与可选文件名补零，同时完善外表写入兼容性，旨在降低查询和 AI 调用开销，让导出文件更易排序。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Lakehouse work uses metadata pruning, partition-value reads and scheduling improvements to avoid unnecessary file access and hotspots. Newly opened priorities cover AI connection reuse and optional filename padding, alongside external-write compatibility, aiming to reduce query and AI overhead and make exported filenames easier to sort.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 实时数仓
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Real-time Data Warehouse

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 实时数仓工作以可选哈希分桶方式为重点，为外部系统桶映射兼容铺路。其余工作围绕持续导入状态持久化、取消与提交协调，以及分区和聚合复用展开，旨在减少重启后的语义漂移、导入阻塞和重复计算。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Real-time warehouse work prioritizes selectable hash bucketing to support bucket-mapping compatibility with external systems. Broader efforts strengthen ingestion-state persistence, cancellation and commit coordination, while improving partition and aggregation reuse, aiming to reduce semantic drift after restarts, ingestion stalls and repeated computation.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 存算分离/云原生
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Compute-Storage Separation & Cloud-Native

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 存算分离集群的元数据规模越大，FE 内存压力越明显。本周通过共享重复的副本路由标识，在生产镜像测试中节省 6.31 GiB 存活堆内存，降幅达 44.2%；同时默认关闭云端 Colocate 一致性哈希，为集群运行提供更保守的默认配置。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Large compute-storage-separated clusters put pressure on FE metadata memory. Sharing duplicate replica route identifiers saved 6.31 GiB of live heap, a 44.2% reduction in a production-image test. Cloud Colocate consistent hashing is also disabled by default, providing a more conservative cluster configuration.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 本周新开的重点工作拟在 master 默认启用文件缓存，与维护分支对齐。由于 BE 配置不持久化，依赖默认值的存算一体集群升级后可能失去缓存；此举旨在保持升级前后的缓存行为一致。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: This week’s new priority proposes enabling file cache by default on master, matching maintained branches. Because BE configurations are not persisted, coupled-storage clusters relying on defaults can lose caching after upgrading. The work aims to preserve cache behavior across upgrades.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: Agent 可观测性
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Agent Observability

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 相关工作正让半结构化数据处理更可预测：正则提取拟支持选择完整匹配或指定捕获组，VARIANT 解析则拟消除可变 BE 配置对错误行为的影响，帮助开发者稳定提取文本并判断无效 JSON。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Work is making semi-structured data processing more predictable: regex extraction would support whole matches or selected capture groups, while VARIANT parsing would remove mutable BE settings that alter error behavior. This aims to give developers reliable text extraction and clearer invalid-JSON handling.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 生态集成
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Ecosystem Integration

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 生态集成正围绕降低迁移和连接障碍推进，重点是 Hive 字符转换语义。本周新开工作尤其关注 MySQL 压缩协议及新版客户端兼容性，并扩展 SQL 格式化、类型查询和 Arrow 支持，旨在减少现有应用接入 Doris 所需的改造。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Integration work targets migration and connectivity barriers, with Hive-compatible character conversion a priority. Newly opened work particularly emphasizes MySQL compression and modern client compatibility, alongside SQL formatting, type inspection and Arrow support, aiming to reduce application changes needed to adopt Doris.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 安全治理
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Security & Governance

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 治理工作正堵住行策略创建成功却未生效的安全缺口，并修复元数据重放后外部表视图的策略创建问题。本周新开的全局动态分区删除保护允许暂停自动清理而继续建分区，旨在同时提高访问控制可靠性和运维保护能力。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Governance work addresses row policies that appear successfully created but remain unenforced, and policy creation on external-backed views after metadata replay. Newly opened global dynamic-partition drop protection would pause automatic cleanup while allowing partition creation, strengthening access-control reliability and operational safeguards.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 内核基础工程
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Kernel & Engineering

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 复杂查询与外部数据访问需要正确结果和可控的资源消耗。本周内核工作收紧内存及并发约束，修正可能漏行的优化与重试行为，并完善类型语义、元数据一致性和进程生命周期处理。跨架构解压、诊断能力及一键基准测试也有所推进，改善执行效率与问题排查。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Complex queries and external data access need correct results and predictable resource use. This week tightened memory and concurrency controls, corrected row-losing optimizations and retries, and strengthened type semantics, metadata consistency, and process lifecycle handling. Cross-architecture decompression, diagnostics, and one-command benchmarks also advanced execution efficiency and troubleshooting.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 内核工作重点推进 SQL 计划管理、查询日志关联和索引空间诊断，并通过可选 JNI 堆准入缓解内存耗尽。本周新开的外部扫描分散调度针对热点，其余新工作持续收敛结果正确性、缓存隔离和资源治理问题，旨在让查询更可靠、更易排障。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Kernel priorities include SQL plan management, query-correlated logs, index-space diagnostics and opt-in JNI heap admission. Newly opened external-scan spreading targets backend hotspots; other new work addresses correctness, cache isolation and resource governance. Together, these efforts aim for more reliable queries and easier troubleshooting.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 存算分离/云原生
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Compute-Storage Separation & Cloud-Native

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 社区希望消除 S3 上传中 Doris 与 AWS SDK 重复计算 MD5 的开销，尤其缓解 aarch64 上的 CPU 瓶颈，在保留校验能力的同时提升存算分离场景的数据写入效率。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: The community wants Doris to eliminate duplicate MD5 hashing between Doris and the AWS SDK during S3 uploads. Reducing this CPU overhead, particularly on aarch64, while preserving checksum validation would improve write efficiency in compute-storage separation deployments.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 生态集成
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Ecosystem Integration

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 社区希望 FE 支持基于 CLIENT_COMPRESS 和 zlib 的 MySQL 压缩协议，让常见数据库客户端、JDBC 工具及 ODBC 分析工具能够使用连接压缩，减少数据传输量，改善带宽受限场景下的访问体验。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: The community wants the FE to support MySQL connection compression through CLIENT_COMPRESS and zlib. This would let mainstream database clients, JDBC tools, and ODBC analytics tools use their existing compression options, reducing network traffic and improving access over bandwidth-constrained connections.

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 安全治理
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Security & Governance

landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..message: 社区希望 Doris 查询外部 Iceberg 表时，执行 REST Catalog 随 loadTable 返回的调用者专属行过滤与列脱敏规则，使组织能够在源 Catalog 统一管理访问策略，并在交互式分析中保留这些访问限制。
landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: The community wants Doris to enforce caller-specific row filters and column masking returned by Iceberg REST Catalog through loadTable when querying external tables. This would let organizations manage access policies centrally in the source catalog while preserving those restrictions during interactive analytics.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.summar.message: 本周，Apache Doris 的演进方向聚焦于更及时的数据摄取、更精准的扫描，以及保留高精度时间信息的湖仓互通，内核与工程仍是社区投入最集中的领域。现代客户端兼容性和外部认证身份绑定也在持续完善，让接入与账户管理更加明确。43 位贡献者推动合并了 176 个 PR，社区新增 20 个 issue，呈现出以工程改进为主、持续拓展实时数仓与湖仓能力的活跃态势。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.summar.description: This week, Apache Doris is moving toward more timely ingestion, more focused scans, and lakehouse interoperability that preserves high-precision timestamps, with kernel and engineering work remaining the community’s largest focus. Compatibility with modern clients and explicit external authentication bindings are also advancing, improving connectivity and clarity in account management. With 43 contributors driving 176 merged PRs and 20 new issues opened, community activity reflects a strong engineering focus alongside continued expansion of real-time warehouse and lakehouse capabilities.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.summar.message: 以 S3 事件驱动实时摄取
Doris 新增通过专用 SQS 队列消费 S3 ObjectCreated 通知的流式摄取，按存储桶和 glob 筛选文件，解决有序列表游标遗漏较小键名文件的问题。这让对象存储数据接入更完整，也推动实时摄取走向事件驱动。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.summar.description: Doris now supports streaming ingestion through S3 ObjectCreated notifications delivered to a dedicated SQS queue, filtering by bucket and glob. This addresses files missed when their keys precede an ordered-listing cursor, improving ingestion completeness and moving object-storage ingestion toward an event-driven model.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.summar.message: 用位图提前缩小共享数据扫描范围
一项开发中的变更提出接收外部 Roaring 位图，并在原生扫描中提前过滤候选资源 ID，另提供可选的压缩运行时过滤器。它面向分类、分面和访问规则等候选集合，探索让大型共享数据集查询更早缩小处理范围。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.summar.description: A proposed change accepts external Roaring bitmaps and filters candidate resource IDs early in native scans, with an optional compressed runtime filter. For candidate sets derived from categories, facets, or access rules, it explores narrowing query work earlier across large shared datasets.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.summar.message: 湖仓互通保留纳秒时间精度
Doris 已将 Iceberg 和 Paimon 的无时区纳秒时间戳双向映射到 TIMESTAMP_NS，在读取、插入和 CTAS 中保留九位小数，覆盖嵌套类型。这减少了跨系统的精度损失，推动湖仓互通从可读取走向类型保真。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.summar.description: Doris now maps unzoned nanosecond timestamps in Iceberg and Paimon bidirectionally to TIMESTAMP_NS, preserving nine fractional digits through reads, inserts, and CTAS, including nested types. This reduces precision loss across systems and advances lakehouse interoperability toward faithful type handling.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.summar.message: 完善现代 MySQL 客户端兼容性
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.summar.description: Broader Compatibility with Modern MySQL Clients

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.summar.message: Doris FE 改进了 MySQL 9 客户端及 Connector/J 8/9 兼容性，覆盖多语句结果、caching_sha2 完整认证、authentication_policy 查询和预处理语句的二进制 TIME 参数。这降低了应用接入摩擦，推动 MySQL 协议兼容覆盖更完整的客户端交互。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.summar.description: Doris FE improves compatibility with MySQL 9 clients and Connector/J 8/9, covering multiple-statement results, caching_sha2 full authentication, authentication_policy queries, and binary TIME parameters in prepared statements. This reduces application integration friction and extends MySQL protocol compatibility across more client interactions.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.summar.message: 将账户明确绑定到外部认证身份
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.summar.description: Explicit Account Bindings for External Authentication

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.summar.message: Doris 已支持将 user@host 账户独占绑定到命名认证集成，由集成验证凭据，并可用 AS 指定外部身份。统一语法适用于 LDAP、IAM 等插件，让账户与外部身份的对应关系更明确，推动认证治理走向显式配置。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.summar.description: Doris now supports exclusive bindings between user@host accounts and named authentication integrations, which verify credentials, with optional AS mappings to external identities. Provider-independent syntax covers LDAP, IAM, and other plugins, making identity relationships clearer and moving authentication governance toward explicit configuration.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 多模湖仓
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Multi-modal Lakehouse

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 湖仓读写本周重点改善外部文件 COUNT 扫描调度，减少重复查询集中落到同一后端。围绕同一链路，Iceberg 写入按转换后分区值路由，补充覆盖模式控制，并完善原生表属性修改、GZIP 写入、Oracle 类型映射及导出文件排序。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Lakehouse work prioritized external-file COUNT scheduling to reduce repeated-query backend hotspots. Partition-aware Iceberg write routing and overwrite-mode controls improve write handling, while native table-property updates, GZIP writes, Oracle type mappings, and optional filename padding broaden interoperability across ingestion, management, and export.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 湖仓查询重点转向直接利用分区元数据，让 Hive/Hudi 最新分区等查询避免打开数据文件，并通过 HMS 下推减少规划开销。Azure 原生访问与三维地理数据兼容同步推进；本周新开 ANN 延迟构建工作，拟将索引成本从导入移至后台合并。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Lakehouse work prioritizes partition-metadata execution so Hive/Hudi latest-partition queries can avoid opening files, alongside HMS pruning to reduce planning overhead. Native Azure access and 3D geometry compatibility broaden interoperability. Newly opened ANN work proposes moving index construction from ingestion to background compaction.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 实时数仓
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Real-time Data Warehouse

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 实时数仓重点削减宽表、多连接点查的缓存内存，移除冗余预分配。持续摄取链路同步强化取消与关闭协调、事务部分更新校验和 CDC 模式变更恢复，并按后端 CPU 调整快照并行度、减少重复模式日志，支持聚合状态直接终结。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Real-time workloads gained lower point-query cache memory usage for wide tables and many connections through reduced preallocation. Ingestion work strengthened cancellation, close coordination, transactional partial-update validation, and CDC schema-change recovery, while adapting snapshot parallelism to backend CPUs, reducing redundant schema journals, and enabling direct aggregate-state finalization.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 实时数仓工作围绕持续摄取的完整性与新鲜数据查询效率，完善 Kinesis 分片生命周期、JSON 配置传递及最新可见分区选择。本周新开工作将预聚合扩展至可合并聚合状态，并修复副本修复期间 binlog 保留期竞争，兼顾分析效率与事件保留可靠性。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Real-time warehouse work targets ingestion continuity and fresh-data access through durable Kinesis shard tracking, JSON configuration propagation and latest-visible-partition selection. Newly opened work extends pre-aggregation to mergeable aggregate states and addresses binlog-retention races during replica repair, improving analytical efficiency and event-retention reliability.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 存算分离/云原生
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Compute-Storage Separation & Cloud-Native

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 云原生运维继续提升状态一致性与存储效率：计算组属性删除和同名重建可正确同步、解析，GCS 回收采用批量删除；文件缓存默认开启，而存在性能隐患的 LRU 转储改为显式启用。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Cloud operations advanced metadata consistency and storage efficiency: compute-group synchronization now handles removed properties and same-name recreation correctly, while GCS recycling uses batch deletion. File caching becomes enabled by default, with potentially problematic LRU dumping requiring explicit opt-in.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 存算分离正围绕远程读取和缓存复用降低查询开销，同时减少 FE 活跃度跟踪内存。本周新开的工作让异步缓存写入支持节点间缓存读取，旨在避免查询线程承担同步写入，与预读、I/O 合并及云端增量查询缓存形成协同。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Cloud work targets remote-read overhead through coordinated prefetching, I/O coalescing and incremental query-cache reuse, while reducing FE activity-tracking memory. Newly opened this week, peer-cache support for asynchronous cache writes aims to keep synchronous cache population off query threads.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: Agent 可观测性
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Agent Observability

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 面向日志与 Agent 数据中的大型 JSON 和密集文本检索，本周将 JSONB 数组遍历改为线性处理，并优化无需评分的倒排索引 AND 查询，减少大数组搜索和高频词组合过滤的开销。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: For large JSON documents and dense text searches in logs and agent data, this week made JSONB array traversal linear and optimized unscored inverted-index conjunctions, reducing overhead when searching large arrays or filtering combinations of common terms.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 生态集成
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Ecosystem Integration

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 面向迁移与客户端接入，本周补齐 Hive 兼容的字符集编解码，修复 TLS 下 MySQL 查询包截断，并将 Flight 元数据、原生 Variant 和 VARBINARY 相关修正移植到 master，减少跨系统连接与类型处理中的兼容障碍。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: For workload migration and client connectivity, this week added Hive-compatible character encoding and decoding, corrected MySQL packet truncation over TLS, and brought Flight metadata, native Variant, and VARBINARY fixes to master, reducing compatibility gaps across system boundaries.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 生态集成侧重让客户端与迁移后的 SQL 行为更可靠：消除 dbt 长语句传输损坏，完善 Flight SQL 元数据过滤与时区兼容，并提供兼容 Trino 的时长格式化，减少工具接入和跨引擎迁移中的意外。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Ecosystem work aims to make client integration and SQL migration more predictable, addressing dbt long-statement corruption and Flight SQL metadata filtering and timezone compatibility. Trino-compatible duration formatting further reduces adaptation work for users moving queries and tools to Doris.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 安全治理
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Security & Governance

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 为需要临时保留历史分区的运维场景，本周新增集群级动态分区删除保护，可暂停后台自动删除，同时继续创建动态分区，让保留数据的操作更可控。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: For operational workflows that temporarily need to retain historical partitions, a new cluster-wide dynamic partition drop-protection setting pauses automatic cleanup while allowing partition creation to continue, giving operators more control over data retention.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 治理工作的重点是建表时配置行级 TTL，以合并后的可见性规则隐藏过期数据，并在自然重写时清理。同时修复行策略创建与元数据重放问题，尤其拒绝可能显示创建成功却未实际生效的关联子查询策略，减少权限配置误判。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Governance work centers on creation-time row TTL, hiding expired rows after merging and removing them during natural rewrites. Policy fixes address metadata-replay failures and reject correlated-subquery policies that could appear successfully created without enforcement, reducing false confidence in access controls.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 内核基础工程
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Kernel & Engineering

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 内核工作围绕复杂查询与湖仓访问的可靠执行展开：统一 MATCH/SEARCH 引擎，修正评分与 SQL 语义，强化并发生命周期和缓存内存治理，同时优化扫描、Variant 读取及广播传输，并补齐外部连接器兼容与诊断。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Kernel work strengthened reliable execution across complex queries and lakehouse access. A unified MATCH/SEARCH engine accompanies scoring and SQL correctness fixes, safer concurrent lifecycles, tighter cache memory control, and more efficient scans, Variant reads, and broadcast transport, alongside connector compatibility and diagnostic improvements.

landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..message: 内核工作持续收紧查询正确性、故障隔离和资源管理。本周新开工作尤其关注优化器改写与数值转换失真、扫描异常导致进程退出，以及缓存内存和分区创建失控，旨在让复杂查询结果可信、运行边界可控，并改善诊断。
landing.reports.2026-10-12.report.repos..description: Kernel work strengthens query correctness, failure isolation and resource control. Newly opened efforts particularly target optimizer and numeric-conversion errors, scanner exceptions that can terminate BE, cache memory budgeting and partition-creation limits, aiming for trustworthy complex-query results, predictable operation and better diagnostics.

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.message: 本周 Doris 社区共有 42 位贡献者推动合并 113 个 PR，实时数仓与内核工程两条主线保持密集迭代。能力范围持续向多模态湖仓、云原生多租户和新一代倒排索引扩展，安全、治理与可观测性也同步加固，实时分析与湖仓融合进一步加速。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.description: This week the Doris community merged 113 PRs with 42 contributors, showing intense iteration around the twin tracks of real-time data warehousing and kernel engineering. The capability footprint is steadily expanding toward multi-modal lakehouse, cloud-native multi-tenancy, and next-generation inverted indexing, with security, governance, and observability hardening in parallel — signaling clear acceleration on real-time analytics and lakehouse convergence.

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.message: 湖仓 Catalog 插件化与写入支持
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.description: Lakehouse catalog plugin-ization and write support

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.message: Doris 启动 Catalog SPI 迁移，将内置连接器从 FE 核心解耦为可加载插件；新增 Apache Paimon 表原生写入支持，并落地 File Scanner v2 读取栈，提供原生 Parquet/CSV/JSON 读取器、列投影与谓词下推，进一步完善多模态湖仓的读写闭环。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.description: Doris kicks off a Catalog SPI migration to decouple built-in connectors from FE core into loadable plugins, adds native write support for Apache Paimon tables, and lands the file scanner v2 reader stack with native Parquet/CSV/JSON readers, projection, and predicate pushdown—tightening the read-write loop for multi-modal lakehouse workloads.

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.message: 实时数仓：查询下推与 IO 裁剪
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.description: Real-time DWH: query pushdown and IO pruning

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.message: 本周新增裁剪后复杂列的延迟读取，以及内部表和 Parquet 扫描中基于表达式的 ZoneMap 裁剪，覆盖比较、IN、IS NULL、starts_with 等条件；自适应全局 Runtime Filter 发布减轻 Coordinator 扇出开销，多阶段谓词延迟物化也在推进，使实时查询的裁剪更精准、IO 更精简。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.description: This week brings lazy reading on pruned complex columns, expression-based ZoneMap pruning (comparisons, IN, IS NULL, starts_with) across internal and Parquet scans, adaptive global runtime filter publishing to ease coordinator fan-out, and ongoing work on multi-stage predicate lazy materialization—sharper pruning and leaner IO for real-time queries.

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.message: 云原生多租户计算与缓存
云模式新增跨计算组的 Peer Read 路由并优化 Peer Cache IO；Rowset 写入与合并支持只缓存索引文件的新选项，以保护热点数据。租户级 Colocation 进入评审，旨在减少多租户 JOIN 的副本冗余，共同提升云环境下的隔离性与缓存效率。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.description: Cloud gains cross-compute-group peer read routing with optimized peer cache IO, a new option to cache only index files during rowset writes and compaction to protect hot data, and tenant-level colocation entering review to cut replica redundancy for multi-tenant JOINs—together improving isolation and cache efficiency in the cloud.

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.message: 启用 enable_https 后，FE 内部通信将升级为 HTTPS，弥补强化部署环境中的明文传输缺口。TDE 新增对阿里云 KMS 和 Ranger KMS 根密钥提供方的识别，并更新云端及 Hadoop/Ranger 端点的 KMS 配置文档，强化密钥管理与传输加密。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.description: Intra-FE communication now upgrades to HTTPS when enable_https is set, closing the plaintext gap in hardened deployments; TDE adds Aliyun KMS and Ranger KMS as recognized root-key providers, with refreshed KMS configuration documentation for cloud and Hadoop/Ranger endpoints—hardening key management and transport encryption.

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.message: 新一代倒排索引与日语分词
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.description: Next-gen inverted index and Japanese tokenization

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.message: 倒排索引新增日语 Kuromoji 形态分析器，修复无空格日语文本的分词，使 MATCH 查询能够端到端运行；同时将 SNII 倒排索引存储格式集成为独立读写路径，提升多语言搜索能力与索引存储效率。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.summar.description: Doris adds a Japanese Kuromoji morphological analyzer to the inverted index, fixing tokenization for space-less Japanese text so MATCH queries work end-to-end, and integrates the SNII inverted index storage format as a separate write/read path—advancing both multilingual search and index storage efficiency.

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..message: 湖仓方面补齐多处缺口：提前拒绝 Iceberg v3 行级血缘隐藏列的名称冲突；COUNT(*) 下推可容忍缺失的快照计数；Parquet/ORC 写入器支持 LZ4；二进制列输出正确的 Arrow 类型而非 utf8；嵌套 Decimal 精度提升也增加了校验。外部写入会清理实际的目标文件。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..description: Lakehouse gaps were closed: Iceberg v3 row-lineage hidden column collisions are rejected up front, COUNT(*) pushdown tolerates missing snapshot counters, Parquet/ORC writers gain LZ4 support, binary columns now emit proper Arrow types instead of utf8, and nested decimal precision promotion is validated. External writes clean up the real target file

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..message: 湖仓工作持续拓展 Iceberg、Hive、Paimon 和 MaxCompute 的读写及治理能力。Iceberg REST 新增 OIDC 用户会话凭证转发，让查询以真实用户身份访问数据；同时推进 OAuth 401 重新认证、Arrow Flight Coordinator 生命周期修复、新版 ORC Format v2 读取器和 Paimon 写入 P0 测试。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..description: Lakehouse work keeps broadening Iceberg/Hive/Paimon/MaxCompute read-write and governance. The key addition of OIDC user-session credential forwarding for Iceberg REST lets queries access data under the real user identity, paired with OAuth 401 re-auth, Arrow Flight coordinator lifetime fixes, the new ORC format v2 reader, and Paimon write P0 to steadily

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..message: 实时数仓的查询与导入路径均得到加固：SimplifyAggGroupBy 检查单射性，避免错误分组；Group Commit 跟踪待处理请求，并隔离复用预处理计划中的 load_ids；递归 CTE 的目标 Block 改为按扫描实例而非按 BE 分发。BE 同时修复 BIGINT_MIN 除法触发 SIGFPE、空子节点等问题。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..description: Real-time DWH query and ingest paths were both hardened: SimplifyAggGroupBy now checks injectivity to avoid wrong grouping, group commit tracks pending requests and isolates reused prepared plans' load_ids, and recursive CTE target blocks are dispatched per scan instance instead of per backend. The BE fixed BIGINT_MIN div SIGFPE, null child

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..message: 动态表流式处理系列新增快照读取能力，是表持续刷新的重要里程碑。此外，MTMV 刷新序列化、Routine Load 目标表切换、最近调度时间可见性，以及通过 SHOW LOAD 查看 INSERT-INTO-SELECT 进度等改进，使导入与刷新更易观测、更可靠。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..description: A highlight of real-time DWH work is the snapshot-read slice of the dynamic table streaming series, a key milestone for continuously refreshing tables; alongside it, MTMV refresh serialization, routine-load target-table switching, last-schedule-time visibility, and INSERT-INTO-SELECT progress through SHOW LOAD make ingestion and refresh far more observable and reliable. Many newly

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..message: 存算分离与云原生工作强调可控性和稳定性：E-230 重试时降低版本缓存 TTL，以获取最新版本；事务内 table_version 改为快照读取，消除自身冲突；并修复 S3 异步提交、文件缓存队列指标、Azure 资源持久化缺失 clazz 和分区存储策略相关问题。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..description: Compute-storage separation and cloud-native work emphasized control and stability: retries on E-230 now drop the version-cache TTL to fetch the freshest version, table_version reads inside transactions switch to snapshot reads to remove self-conflicts, and bugs in S3 async submission, file-cache queue metrics, Azure resource persistence (missing clazz), and partition storage-policy

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..message: 本周持续完善 Meta Service、文件缓存和分层存储。修复 Cloud Recycler 的 S3 超时、Alter 后主动同步 Tablet 元数据，以及按能力启用 MS_TOO_BUSY 错误，提升跨版本稳定性和可运维性；同时推进预热任务指标、按阈值停止远端缓存写入、并行 LRU 恢复和 TopN 延迟物化。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..description: Compute-storage separation work this week sharpens Meta Service, file cache, and tiered storage. Fixes for cloud recycler S3 timeouts, proactive tablet meta sync after alter, and capability-gated MS_TOO_BUSY errors improve cross-version stability and operability, while new warm-up job metrics, threshold-based remote cache write cutoff, parallel LRU restore, and TopN lazy-materialization

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..message: 半结构化与索引路径得到加固：VARIANT 合并能够正确区分根路径和空键，避免将其错误归入稀疏列；FE 加强倒排索引 char_filter 替换配置校验；BE 修复索引谓词中 NULL 字面量导致的崩溃，并完善生成列处理。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..description: Half-structured and indexing paths were hardened this week: variant compaction now correctly distinguishes the root path from empty keys instead of forcing them into sparse columns, FE tightens inverted-index char_filter replacement validation, and the BE fixes a crash from NULL literals in index predicates while properly handling generated columns in

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..message: 为防止用户回放历史 DDL 时静默创建倒排索引 V1，社区正在 FE 侧增加 V1 创建限制，使索引格式的选择更加明确，并避免绕过小文件合并与打包路径带来的存储放大。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..description: To prevent tables from silently being created with inverted index V1 when users replay historical DDL, the community is gating V1 creation at the FE so index format stays intentional and storage amplification from bypassing small-file merging and packed paths is avoided.

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..message: 外部生态的兼容性进一步增强：Arrow Flight SQL 跳过刻意产生 NULL Map Key 的场景；Bitmap 断言改为通过 bitmap_to_string 而非原始字节比较，规避 Arrow Map 不支持 NULL Key 的限制，保持 JDBC 与 Arrow 回归输出一致。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..description: External ecosystem paths are more robust: Arrow Flight SQL now skips cases that intentionally yield null map keys, and bitmap assertions compare via bitmap_to_string instead of raw bytes, working around Arrow Map's lack of null-key support so JDBC and Arrow regression outputs stay aligned.

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..message: dbt-doris 正在修复阻碍全新检出环境开发的测试依赖问题，通过重新对齐 dbt-tests-adapter 来源并补齐缺失包，让社区贡献者能够恢复适配器开发。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..description: The dbt-doris adapter's broken test dependencies that have blocked fresh-checkout development are being repaired by re-aligning the dbt-tests-adapter source and filling missing packages, enabling community contributors to iterate on the adapter again.

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..message: 安全工作缩小了凭证暴露面：Kafka Routine Load 的自定义属性在 SHOW 和 information_schema 中脱敏，避免 SASL、SSL、AWS 凭证泄漏；通过新的 BE 配置限制 _stream_load_forward，阻止未认证 SSRF；brpc TLS 移除额外 BIO 缓冲，修复大型 Meta Service 响应中的 TLS 写入问题。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..description: Security work narrowed the credential-exposure surface: Kafka routine-load custom properties are now masked in SHOW and information_schema to prevent SASL/SSL/AWS credential leaks, _stream_load_forward is gated by a new BE config to block unauthenticated SSRF, brpc TLS drops the extra BIO buffer to fix TLS write issues on large meta-service responses,

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..message: 安全与治理工作继续强化传输加密和依赖管理：Go SDK 默认启用 TLS 校验；限制 doris-compose、dbt-doris 和 cost_model 中存在已知 CVE 的 Python 包版本；启用 enable_https 时，将 FE 内部 HTTP URL 统一为 HTTPS，减少明文传输和不安全组件带来的缺口。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..description: Security and governance work this week tightens transport encryption and dependency hygiene: enabling TLS verification by default in the Go SDK, capping Python packages with known CVEs in doris-compose, dbt-doris, and cost_model, and normalizing internal FE HTTP URLs to https when enable_https is on, closing plaintext and insecure-component gaps across

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..message: 内核修复覆盖多类崩溃与正确性问题：高 EPS 下 bvar take_sample 的 SIGSEGV、AsyncIO Worker 缺失 ThreadContext、缺失存储策略预检查、BIGINT_MIN DIV -1 的 SIGFPE、Block 序列化异常逃逸、Pipeline 调度器泄漏 std::exception、Workload Group 智能指针循环引用，以及未检查的任务执行器扫描句柄。FE 也加强了复杂类型相关校验。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..description: Kernel work swept up crashes and correctness traps: SIGSEGV in bvar take_sample under high EPS, missing ThreadContext on AsyncIO workers, missing storage-policy pre-checks, SIGFPE on BIGINT_MIN DIV -1, escaping block-serialization exceptions, std::exception leaks in the pipeline scheduler, workload-group smart-pointer cycles, and unchecked task executor scan handles. FE now rejects complex

landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..message: 本周内核工作兼顾稳定性、性能与开发体验。云模式随机分桶导入的自适应路由在 FE 分配候选桶、在 BE 本地路由，消除发送端重分布开销；Schema Change、事务回滚、Arrow/Parquet/ORC 解码和表达式求值也持续得到加固。
landing.reports.2026-06-29.report.repos..description: Kernel work this week balances stability, performance, and developer experience. The highlighted cloud-mode adaptive routing for random bucket load assigns candidate buckets on the FE and routes locally on the BE, removing sender-side reshuffle cost; alongside it, schema change, txn rollback, Arrow/Parquet/ORC decoding, and expression evaluation keep getting hardened, while

landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.summar.message: 增量计算：行级 Binlog、Table Stream 与 MTMV 协同
landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.summar.description: Incremental computation: row binlog, Table Stream, and MTMV unification

landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.summar.message: 本周补齐增量处理链路的关键环节：Table Stream 支持快照读取；MTMV 分区血缘去重，降低 FE 开销；MySQL 的 ADD/DROP COLUMN 变更可流入流式任务。结合行级 Binlog 的持续推进，Doris 正将流式与批量增量处理汇聚到统一引擎层。
landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.summar.description: This week fills in key pieces of the incremental pipeline: Table Stream gains snapshot reads, MTMV partition lineage is deduplicated to cut FE cost, and MySQL ADD/DROP columns now flow through streaming jobs. Together with the row-binlog tracking, signal Doris is converging stream and batch increments onto one engine layer.

landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.summar.message: 云模式与存算分离存储层：文件缓存、元数据缓存与时间旅行

landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.summar.message: 云模式新增 Time Travel，支持按时间点进行审计查询；外部表文件缓存持久化表和分区上下文，Footer 元数据落盘并支持运行时容量调整；自适应随机分桶路由减轻导入 Writer 压力，持续完善存算分离的存储栈。
landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.summar.description: Cloud mode adds Time Travel for point-in-time audit queries, while external-table file caches now persist table/partition context and footer metadata lands on disk with runtime capacity adjustment. Adaptive random-bucket routing trims load writer pressure, rounding out the decoupled storage stack.

landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.summar.message: 湖仓读写两端的集成都在深化：Iceberg REST Catalog 支持 OIDC 会话凭证与嵌套列 DDL；Paimon JNI 读取接入 IOManager，并落地 JNI 写入支持。FE 元数据缓存重构为后续格式扩展奠定基础，ANN 预过滤则提高向量检索的选择性。
landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.summar.description: Lakehouse integration deepens on both sides: Iceberg REST Catalog gains OIDC session credentials and nested-column DDL, while Paimon JNI reads wire up IOManager and JNI write support lands. The FE metadata cache refactor sets up future formats, and ANN pre-filtering sharpens vector search selectivity.

landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.summar.message: 查询优化器：DPHyper 统计、唯一性传播、提前聚合、Hash Join 与延迟物化
landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.summar.description: Query optimizer: DPHyper stats, unique propagation, eager agg, hash join, lazy materialization

landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.summar.message: 优化器重点完善代价估算与属性传播：DPHyper 在 JOIN 枚举后刷新统计信息；LogicalJoin 合并多列唯一性集合；Distinct 聚合基于统计信息融入提前聚合。Hash Join 在全匹配探测路径中避免复制，多阶段谓词延迟物化也为后续自动调优和降低物化开销奠定基础。
landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.summar.description: The optimizer focuses on cost and propagation signals: DPhyper refreshes statistics after join enumeration, LogicalJoin now unions multi-column unique sets, and distinct aggregation folds into eager agg driven by stats. Hash-join probes avoid copying in the all-match path, and multi-stage predicate lazy materialization sets up future auto-tuning for lighter materialization.

landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.summar.message: 索引能力向多语言与混合检索扩展：倒排索引新增基于 Kuromoji 的日语分词，SNII 作为并行存储路径落地，ANN TopN 在向量扫描前下推可预过滤的列谓词。REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL_ARRAY 进一步补充文本处理工具集。
landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.summar.description: Indexing expands for multilingual and hybrid search: the inverted index adds Kuromoji-based Japanese tokenization, SNII lands as a parallel storage path, and ANN TopN pushes pre-filterable column predicates before the vector scan. REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL_ARRAY rounds out the text-processing toolkit.

landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.repos..description: Lakehouse work this week deepened Doris's read paths across Iceberg, Paimon, ORC and external catalogs. landing.reports.2026-07-06.report.repos..description: Real-time data warehouse work keeps refining the planner, ingest path, and scanner efficiency. landing.reports.2026-07-13.report.summar.message: ANN 向量检索完善：导入时跳过建索引与预过滤 TopN
landing.reports.2026-07-13.report.summar.description: ANN vector search maturity: skip-on-load + pre-filtered TopN

landing.reports.2026-07-13.report.summar.message: ANN 索引支持在导入时跳过构建，延后至 Compaction 阶段执行；当列谓词无法利用 ZoneMap、倒排或 Bitmap 索引时，ANN TopN 仍可使用。这些改进降低向量导入延迟，并提升带过滤条件的近邻查询可靠性。
landing.reports.2026-07-13.report.summar.description: Doris now lets ANN indexes skip construction during load and defer it to compaction, and keeps ANN TopN usable when column predicates fall outside zonemap, inverted, and bitmap indexes. Together they cut vector ingest latency and make filtered nearest-neighbor queries more reliable.

landing.reports.2026-07-13.report.summar.message: Iceberg 与开放湖格式：Position Delete 与 VARIANT 读取
landing.reports.2026-07-13.report.summar.description: Iceberg & open lake formats: position deletes + variant reads

landing.reports.2026-07-13.report.summar.message: Doris 新增 Iceberg $position_deletes 系统表的原生读取，支持读取以 Parquet 存储的 Iceberg v3 VARIANT 列，并引入 lance-c 第三方依赖，拓展开放湖格式的可观测性与半结构化查询能力。
landing.reports.2026-07-13.report.summar.description: Doris adds native Iceberg $position_deletes system-table reads, gains support for Iceberg v3 VARIANT columns stored as Parquet, and pulls in lance-c as a third-party dependency, broadening observability and semi-structured querying over open lake formats.

landing.reports.2026-07-13.report.summar.message: 外部存储缓存层：文件元数据持久化

landing.reports.2026-07-13.report.summar.description: External Parquet/ORC footer metadata now persists to a disk cache behind the existing FileMetaCache interface, surviving BE restarts and eviction, while remote scans past the useful cache-write budget stop writing new entries to avoid wasted I/O.

landing.reports.2026-07-13.report.summar.description: TopN lazy materialization and statistics-driven distinct pushdown are rebuilt, bitmap_count and AVG serialized merges go vectorized, set operators switch to batch hash tables with bucket shuffle, and stale query cache entries merge incrementally to cut repeated hot-partition aggregation cost.
