landing.reports.2026-07-20.report.repos..description: Kernel engineering advanced on three fronts: a shared `RowKeyEncoder` deduplicates primary-key encoding across segment writers, PDEP/AVX2 vectorize bit unpacking and the AVG serialized-state merge becomes vectorized, and correctness fixes land for pre-epoch Arrow timestamps, const-column block merge, BlockingQueue waiter accounting, array_difference OOB, and brpc secondary-package alias ownership. CI converges on

landing.reports.2026-07-20.report.repos..message: 本周内核工程工作密集，重点包括通过租户级 Colocation 降低多租户副本冗余，以及将 Parquet 微基准纳入性能 CI 门禁。新合并修复覆盖 Arrow 时区、Rowset 写入失败、池化扫描器线程之间的 JNI 异常污染，以及外部表元数据缓存等问题。
landing.reports.2026-07-20.report.repos..description: Kernel engineering is especially busy this week, headlined by tenant-level Colocation (key) to break multi-tenant replica redundancy and the move of Parquet microbenchmarks into the performance CI gate (key). Newly merged fixes span Arrow timezones, rowset write failures, JNI exception poisoning across pooled scanner threads, external-table metadata caches, and a

landing.reports.2026-07-20.report.repos..message: 社区强调，调度时行级 Binlog Tablet 必须与基表 Tablet 位于同一 BE、同一存储路径，防止副本修复或负载均衡导致上下游错位，从而保障实时工作负载的 CDC 管线一致性与端到端低延迟。
landing.reports.2026-07-20.report.repos..description: The community emphasizes that row-binlog tablets must remain co-located with their base tablets on the same backend and storage path during scheduling, preventing replica repair or balancing from misaligning upstream and downstream. This safeguards CDC pipeline consistency and end-to-end low latency for real-time workloads.

landing.reports.2026-07-20.report.repos..message: 社区希望 dbt-doris 将异步物化视图作为正式的 dbt Materialization，让用户通过熟悉的 dbt 工作流管理 Doris 的增量刷新视图。这将连接 dbt 的转换建模与 Doris 的高性能预计算，增强其与现代 ELT 栈的互操作性。
landing.reports.2026-07-20.report.repos..description: The community wants dbt-doris to expose async materialized views as a first-class dbt materialization, so users can manage Doris's incrementally refreshed views through familiar dbt workflows. This bridges dbt's transformation modeling with Doris's high-performance precomputation, strengthening Doris's interoperability within modern ELT stacks.

landing.reports.2026-07-20.report.repos..message: 社区提出新增 SHOW TSO STATUS SQL 命令，让客户端无需 HTTP 调用即可检查全局 TSO 的物理时钟和逻辑时钟，改善可观测性、调试与运维自动化，提升核心引擎的易用性。
landing.reports.2026-07-20.report.repos..description: The community requests a SHOW TSO STATUS SQL command so clients can inspect the global TSO's physical and logical clocks without HTTP calls. This improves observability, debugging, and operational automation, delivering a meaningful usability upgrade to Doris's core engine.

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.message: 本周 Doris 社区共有 47 位贡献者推动合并 79 个 PR，Issue 活跃度持续保持。能力建设明显聚焦实时数仓和内核工程，同时加速迈向湖仓与云原生存算分离架构。Catalog SPI、云原生文件缓存和云模式 MoW 吞吐量等重点工作，与 Iceberg/Hive 读写能力对齐、Colocation、Runtime Filter 和优化器下推同步推进，持续建设兼顾查询性能与弹性扩展的云原生湖仓引擎。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.description: This week the Doris community merged 79 PRs from 47 contributors with sustained issue activity, with the capability lines clearly converging on real-time data warehouse and kernel engineering while accelerating toward lakehouse and compute-storage-separated, cloud-native architectures. Headline work on Catalog SPI, cloud-native file cache, and cloud-mode MOW throughput advances alongside Iceberg/Hive read-write parity and colocation/runtime-filter/optimizer pushdowns, signaling strong momentum toward a cloud-native, lakehouse-integrated engine built around query performance and elastic scale.

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.message: Catalog SPI：将外部 Catalog 改造为可加载插件
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.description: Catalog SPI: external catalogs as loadable plugins

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.message: 外部 Catalog 已从 FE 核心解耦并重构为可加载连接器插件，涉及 1700 多个文件、新增约 17.7 万行代码，将 Hive、Iceberg、Paimon 等多模态访问逻辑移出内核。新的 Catalog SPI 以插件交付湖仓能力，使适配器升级不必再等待 Doris 整体发版。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.description: External catalogs have been decoupled from the FE core and refactored as loadable connector plugins (1700+ files, +177k lines), moving multi-modal access (Hive, Iceberg, Paimon, ...) out of the kernel. The new Catalog SPI ships lakehouse capabilities as plugins, so adapter upgrades no longer wait on Doris releases.

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.message: 云原生文件缓存与存储分层
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.description: Cloud-native file cache and storage tiering

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.message: OLAP 与外部 Catalog 的文件缓存改为独立管理，外部扫描持久化表和分区上下文；缓存写入从查询线程移出，采用异步执行；感知 CPU 的 S3 限流器控制远端 IO。云存储分层因此更精准、更稳定，有助于控制湖仓延迟与成本。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.description: File caches for OLAP and external catalogs are now managed independently, with persisted table/partition context for external scans; cache writes go async off the query thread, and a CPU-aware S3 rate limiter caps remote IO. Cloud tiers become more precise and stable, keeping lakehouse latency and cost in check.

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.message: 云模式 MoW 吞吐量：异步发布、Binlog Tablet 与 Table Stream
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.description: Cloud-mode MOW throughput: async publish, binlog tablets, table streams

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.message: 云模式高并发 MoW 写入新增异步发布；行级 Binlog 拆分为独立 Binlog Tablet；Cloud Table Stream 控制面负责由 Meta Service 驱动的提交。导入瓶颈得到缓解，存算分离架构中的增量消费链路进一步闭环。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.description: High-concurrency MOW writes in cloud mode gain async publish; row binlog is split into independent binlog tablets, and a Cloud Table Stream control plane owns MetaService-driven commits. The ingest bottleneck eases and incremental consumption closes the loop in disaggregated storage.

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.message: Iceberg/Hive 湖仓写入端与读取端完善
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.description: Iceberg/Hive write-side and reader-side lakehouse work

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.message: Hive 新增静态分区覆盖并配备回归测试；Iceberg V3 区分 Initial Default 与 Write Default，使读取符合规范；ORC/Parquet 支持按选择性排列合取条件；BE 侧 Paimon Rust 读取器原型落地，兼顾读取正确性、写入合规性和扫描成本。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.description: Hive gains static partition overwrite with regression coverage; Iceberg V3 separates initial vs write defaults so reads match spec; ORC/Parquet add selectivity-aware conjunct ordering; a Paimon Rust reader prototype lands on BE. Reads stay correct, writes stay compliant, scans stay cheap.

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.message: Colocation、Runtime Filter 与优化器下推
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.description: Colocation, runtime filters, and optimizer pushdowns

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.message: Colocation 扩展到感知租户的副本规划，并基于约束推断分布；迟到的 Runtime Filter 可下推至 Segment Iterator；优化器新增 BUCKET Hint 和单调函数谓词下推。规划器、执行器和存储层共同降低大型查询延迟。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.summar.description: Colocation extends to tenant-aware replica planning with constraint-based distribution inference; late runtime filters now push into segment iterators; a BUCKET hint and monotonic-function predicate pushdown join the optimizer. Planner, executor, and storage now shave big-query latency together.

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..message: Paimon、Iceberg 与 Parquet 湖仓栈持续完善：BE 读取 Paimon 时不再重建 Catalog Metastore；新增 paimon.table-option.* 透传与查询级动态选项，并补齐回归覆盖；修复 Iceberg 历史读取和嵌套 Schema 演进；V2 延迟字典与直接谓词降低 TPC-DS 稀疏 Runtime Filter 扫描的 CPU 开销。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..description: The lakehouse stack matures across Paimon, Iceberg and Parquet: Paimon reads on BE no longer reconstruct the catalog metastore, paimon.table-option.* passthrough and query-level dynamic options land with regression coverage, Iceberg historical reads and nested schema evolution are fixed, V2 lazy dictionary and direct predicates cut TPC-DS sparse RF scan CPU,

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..message: 多模态湖仓继续提升读写质量，近期重点完善元数据缓存与刷新语义：查询 Iceberg 的 information_schema 时不再因逐表 loadTable 而阻塞；SHOW TABLES 避免提前预热所有条目；Paimon JNI 新增表缓存以缓解内存压力，并持续补齐兼容性缺口。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..description: This group advances read/write quality for the multi-modal lakehouse. landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..description: Real-time DWH correctness and planner stability both improve: TIMESTAMPTZ dynamic partitions align to UTC midnight across DST, outer-join null-reject inference is bounded to its own nullable outputs, TopN/MV/MTMV pruning rules are tightened, bitmap_count composite rewrites, fixed-key packing and scalar auto-vectorization lift execution, and V2 readers push predicates directly.

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..message: 实时数仓继续完善性能和正确性。重点能力包括更简单的行级 TTL、按列压缩，以及 uniq_theta 近似去重计数聚合，降低生命周期管理和高基数去重成本。新提交还加强 Kafka 计算组隔离、低延迟任务的自适应批处理、运行中 Nereids INSERT 的取消，以及 CTE 拆分。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..description: This group continues to refine real-time DWH performance and correctness. Highlight capabilities include simplified row-level TTL, per-column compression, and the uniq_theta approximate distinct-count aggregate for lighter lifecycle and high-cardinality dedup. Newer commits tighten Kafka compute-group isolation, adaptive batching behavior on low-lag tasks, cancellation of running Nereids INSERTs, CTE splitting to

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..message: 云原生控制面继续加固：旧客户端不再将未知 MetaServiceCode 视为成功；BE 预热任务数量可观测；从 Meta Service 请求中过滤非 MoW Tablet 和被忽略的 Tablet 属性；紧急导入不能挤占 Schema Change 锁；虚拟 Tablet 位置限制在当前计算组内。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..description: Cloud-native hardening tightens the control plane: old clients no longer treat unknown MetaServiceCode as success, BE warm-up job count is now observable, non-MOW tablets and ignored tablet properties are filtered from MS traffic, urgent loads cannot displace schema-change locks, and dummy tablet locations stay within the current compute group.

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..message: 存算分离与云原生栈继续深化。通过 GKE Workload Identity 实现免密钥 GCS Vault，以及支持 S3 Express One Zone 的区域桶，使对象存储访问更符合云部署习惯。新提交进一步隔离计算组内 Kafka 元数据，并推进按分区滚动升级倒排索引格式。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..description: This group deepens the compute-storage decoupled and cloud-native stack. Highlight work such as keyless GCS vaults via GKE Workload Identity and S3 Express One Zone zonal-bucket support makes object storage access feel native to cloud deployments. Newer commits add Kafka metadata isolation within compute groups, per-partition inverted-index format rollout for

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..message: 本周 VARIANT 工作负载新增原生 ColumnVariantV2 执行路径，采用 Parquet Variant Encoding v1；同时修复被 Nullable 包裹的 Array 元素无法识别为 NestedGroup 的问题，保持哈希与查询语义一致。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..description: Variant-type workloads advance this week with a native ColumnVariantV2 execution path adopting Parquet Variant Encoding v1, complemented by a fix that lets array elements wrapped in Nullable be recognized as NestedGroup, keeping hashing and query semantics consistent.

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..message: 倒排索引与 VARIANT 能力持续发展。Kuromoji 日语分析器弥补无空格日语文本在 MATCH 查询中的分词缺口；SNII 存储格式和按分区从 V2 滚动升级至 V3 的机制，支持索引格式原位演进。新 PR 还增加了嵌套 VARIANT 的 MATCH 查询支持。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..description: This group pushes Doris's inverted-index and Variant capabilities forward. Highlight work like the Kuromoji Japanese analyzer closes the segmentation gap for space-less Japanese text in MATCH queries, while the SNII storage format and per-partition V2-to-V3 rolling-upgrade machinery let index formats evolve in place. Newly opened PRs add nested Variant MATCH

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..message: 生态集成落地 Arrow Flight SQL 修复，使 GetTables 返回的 Schema 描述与实际数据一致，并修正 TIMESTAMPTZ 的 Arrow 读取器，提升外部客户端消费 Doris 数据的可靠性。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..description: Ecosystem integration lands an Arrow Flight SQL fix aligning GetTables' schema description with the data it sends and correcting the TIMESTAMPTZ arrow reader, so external clients consume Doris reliably.

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..message: 生态集成重点对齐 Doris 与外部执行生态的数据类型。正在修复 DATETIME 被 Arrow 暴露为带时区时间戳的问题，使 Remote Doris 等消费者获取稳定的原始值，避免仅修改 Schema 就静默改变本地时钟时间。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..description: This group addresses data-type alignment between Doris and external execution ecosystems. The active work fixes DATETIME being exposed to Arrow as a timezone-aware timestamp, so consumers such as Remote Doris now receive stable raw values without silent wall-clock shifts when only the schema changes.

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..message: 安全加固在反序列化时保留旧版长名称用户属性字段；通过组件级匹配收紧 JDBC 驱动 URL 校验；强化相关敏感配置；移除不必要的 FE 文件上传 HTTP 接口，缩小攻击面。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..description: Security hardening preserves legacy long-named user-property fields during deserialization, locks down JDBC driver URL validation with component-based matching, hardens related sensitive configs, and retires an unnecessary FE file-upload HTTP surface to shrink the attack area.

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..message: 认证、授权和凭证治理持续收紧。重点变更默认启用 FE HTTP API 认证并修复相关问题；ALTER USER 支持兼容 MySQL 的双密码 RETAIN/DISCARD 语义，实现在线凭证轮换。新增工作补齐多条 Nereids 命令的权限检查，并在 RESOURCE 语句日志中隐藏 ai.api_key。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..description: This group tightens authentication, authorization, and credential governance. The highlight change enables FE HTTP API authentication by default and repairs related bugs, while MySQL-compatible dual-password semantics (RETAIN/DISCARD) on ALTER USER enable online credential rotation. New work adds missing privilege checks for several Nereids commands, redacts ai.api_key from RESOURCE statement logs,

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..message: 内核继续向可演进架构发展：插件元数据可通过 information_schema.plugins 查询；FE 存储统一至文件系统 SPI，连接器插件自行管理配置，并移除旧 Hadoop 导入；升级涉及 CVE 的依赖；修复字典刷新、导入 Quorum、聚合哈希和 Rollup 状态等问题。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..description: Kernel work moves toward an evolvable core: plugin metadata is now queryable in information_schema.plugins, FE storage is unified behind the filesystem SPI with connector plugins owning their own configs and hadoop legacy imports removed, CVE-flagged dependencies are upgraded, and fixes touch dictionary refresh, load quorum, aggregate hash, rollup state, while

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..message: 内核加固的重点是将 DATETIMEV2 精度从小数点后六位扩展到纳秒级，以有符号 Int64 存储 Epoch 纳秒，同时保留现有语义。新提交还覆盖 Apache Arrow 24 升级、WAL 回放类型校验、纵向合并偏移修正、稀疏合并路径及索引查找。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..description: This group hardens the kernel. The highlight effort extends DATETIMEV2 precision beyond six fractional digits into nanosecond scales via a signed Int64 epoch-nanosecond physical representation while preserving existing semantics. Newer commits cover the Apache Arrow 24 upgrade, WAL replay type validation, vertical compaction offset corrections, sparse-compaction merge paths, and index-lookup

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..message: 社区正通过集成 Lance Catalog、Lance 数据集访问和向量检索，将 Doris 4.2 建设为多模态湖仓。工作覆盖 Catalog 接入、读写路径和完整验证，使用户能通过统一引擎管理表格与向量化湖仓工作负载。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..description: The community is shaping Doris 4.2 into a multi-modal lakehouse by integrating Lance Catalog, Lance dataset access, and vector search. The work spans catalog wiring, read/write paths, and full verification so users can manage both tabular and vectorized lakehouse workloads from a single engine.

landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..message: 实时数仓工作关注数据生命周期和更丰富的聚合。新的行级 TTL 为 DUPLICATE KEY 表提供逐行过期能力，保持集群精简；基于 Theta Sketch 的近似去重计数聚合支持集合运算，补充 HLL 能力，提高高基数实时分析的精度。
landing.reports.2026-07-27.report.repos..description: Real-time warehouse work targets data lifecycle and richer aggregations. A new row-level TTL enables per-row expiration on DUPLICATE KEY tables to keep clusters lean, while a Theta-sketch based approximate distinct-count aggregate complements HLL by supporting set operations, improving precision for high-cardinality real-time analytics.

landing.reports.2026-08-03.report.summar.message: 本周 Apache Doris 共有 46 位贡献者推动合并 89 个 PR，内核工程与实时数仓合计涉及 123 项工作；存算分离、云原生和多模态湖仓构成第二条增长主线，安全与治理、Agent 可观测性和生态集成也同步推进。Iceberg/Paimon/Lance/Fluss Catalog 融合、可调且可观测的云原生存储，以及解耦的行级 Binlog/TSO 三大方向，指向同一目标：以更强的执行内核统一湖仓、对象存储和流式路径，形成面向生产的实时分析平台。
landing.reports.2026-08-03.report.summar.description: Apache Doris saw 89 merged PRs from 46 contributors this week, with momentum concentrated in Kernel & Engineering and Real-time Data Warehouse (123 items combined), followed by Compute-Storage Separation/Cloud-Native and Multi-modal Lakehouse as a second growth axis, while security & governance, agent observability and ecosystem integration round out the picture. The three headline directions—converging Iceberg/Paimon/Lance/Fluss catalogs, tunable and observable cloud-native storage, and decoupled row binlog/TSO—point to one trajectory: Doris is unifying the lakehouse, object storage and streaming paths on a stronger execution kernel, converging toward a production-grade real-time analytics platform.

landing.reports.2026-08-10.report.summar.message: 本周 Doris 社区沿实时数仓与内核工程两条主线推进，云原生和湖仓工作也持续加强，共合并 77 个 PR，44 位贡献者参与。重点能力包括 VARIANT V2 原生 Shredded 执行、云端文件缓存和湖仓连接器写入路径，并辅以 MTMV 增量维护、TIMESTAMP_NS 等内核改进，协同提升查询性能、存算分离和多模态湖仓能力。生态集成、安全与治理同步进展，社区整体保持稳定发展。
landing.reports.2026-08-10.report.summar.description: This week, the Doris community advanced along two parallel tracks — real-time data warehouse and kernel engineering — while cloud-native and lakehouse efforts continued to ramp up, with 77 PRs merged and 44 contributors participating. landing.reports.2026-08-10.report.repos..description: Security and governance work is hardening authentication and encryption. landing.reports.2026-08-10.report.repos..description: Kernel and engineering work this week tilts heavily toward BE build-time speed-up and plumbing rigor. landing.reports.2026-08-10.report.repos..description: Kernel engineering spans types, functions, storage, and build pipelines. Create-time Row TTL lands with a hidden TTL column, TIMESTAMP_NS gains its cast and function matrix, Trino-compatible bounding-box accessors arrive, table-schema HTTP APIs expose structured type metadata, and a new Web UI foundation is seeded. A focused build-speed series cuts cold

landing.reports.2026-08-10.report.repos..message: 面向实时数仓，社区正推进两项重点：将 TIMESTAMP_NS 建设为端到端支持的数据类型，覆盖语法、FE/BE 类型系统、存储、导入、输出协议与生态兼容；引入 GLOBAL_POINT 索引，通过跨 Tablet 裁剪，让 `WHERE c = X` 等点查更快、成本更低。两者共同改善高基数、纳秒精度和高 QPS 工作负载的实时分析体验。
landing.reports.2026-08-10.report.repos..description: For real-time warehousing, the community is driving two priorities: elevating TIMESTAMP_NS into a fully supported end-to-end data type spanning syntax, FE/BE type systems, storage, ingestion, output protocols, and ecosystem compatibility; and introducing a GLOBAL_POINT index that enables cross-tablet pruning so point lookups such as `WHERE c = X` resolve faster and more cheaply. Together they sharpen Doris's real-time analytics on high-cardinality, nanosecond-precision, and high-QPS workloads.

landing.reports.2026-08-10.report.repos..message: 社区希望将 IPv6 绑定支持扩展至 doris_cloud 和 Meta Service，使 Doris 云原生部署适应现代网络。此前 BE/FE 已具备相关支持，补齐云层后，存算分离集群即可原生运行在 IPv6 或双栈环境中，减少生产环境对 NAT 的依赖。
landing.reports.2026-08-10.report.repos..description: The community wants Doris's cloud-native deployment to align with modern networking by extending IPv6 binding to doris_cloud and the Meta Service. With prior work already covering BE/FE, bringing the cloud tier up to par lets compute-storage-separated clusters run natively on IPv6 or dual-stack environments, easing reliance on NAT in production.

landing.reports.2026-08-10.report.repos..message: 面向生态兼容，社区希望内置兼容 Spark 和 Hive 的 stack 表值生成函数，补齐 BuiltinTableGeneratingFunctions 中的能力缺口，避免用户迁移 Spark/Hive 管线时编写自定义 UDF，增强 Doris 与大数据生态的 SQL 互操作性。
landing.reports.2026-08-10.report.repos..description: Centered on ecosystem compatibility, the community is asking Doris to ship a built-in stack table-generating function compatible with Spark and Hive, filling the gap left in BuiltinTableGeneratingFunctions. The goal is to spare users from writing custom UDFs when migrating Spark/Hive pipelines and tighten Doris's SQL interoperability with the broader big-data ecosystem.

landing.reports.2026-08-10.report.repos..message: 工程方面，社区希望 Web UI SQL 控制台记住用户的查询历史及对应结果集，补齐长期存在的易用性缺口。缓存近期执行结果可减少重复运行即席语句的成本，也便于复现和分享发现，提升整体可运维性。
landing.reports.2026-08-10.report.repos..description: On the engineering front, the community wants the Web UI SQL console to remember a user's query history along with their returned result sets, closing a long-standing usability gap. Caching recent runs reduces the cost of re-executing ad-hoc statements and makes it easier to reproduce and share findings, raising Doris's overall operability.

landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.summar.message: 本周 Doris 合并 97 个 PR，49 位贡献者在七个重点方向推进 170 多项变更。内核工程与实时数仓依然领先，存算分离、多模态湖仓和 Agent 可观测性也在同步加速。能力重心逐渐转向对象存储原生的云原生引擎与统一湖仓读写路径，VARIANT V2、企业安全治理扩展点，以及供下游实现使用的可插拔开源 SPI 正构成新的产品基础。Doris 正从高性能分析型数据库，演进为原生运行于对象存储、同时服务实时分析和开放湖仓的数据底座。
landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.summar.description: Doris landed 97 PRs this week with 49 contributors driving 170+ changes across seven focus areas, with kernel engineering and the real-time data warehouse still leading the mix while compute-storage separation, the multi-modal lakehouse, and agent observability continue to accelerate in parallel. The capability gravity is clearly shifting toward an object-storage-native cloud-native engine with unified lakehouse read/write paths, with Variant V2, enterprise security/governance extension points, and pluggable open-source SPIs for downstream implementations forming the next product baseline. For anyone sizing up where Doris is headed, the signal this week is clear: it is evolving from a high-performance analytical database into a multi-modal data foundation that runs natively on object storage and serves both real-time analytics and open lakehouse workloads.

landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.summar.description: Async cache writes, page prefetch, and I/O coalescing keep cold scans off the query thread; the SNII inverted index reads object storage directly without local rebuild; BE and Recycler now share one object client with consistent credentials, errors, and metrics; a backend-selection extension framework lands. Cold-start latency, operational consistency, and

landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.summar.description: Lakehouse write and read paths reach parity

landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.summar.message: Paimon 2.0 事务写入补齐外部表写入能力；Iceberg 延迟打开 HDFS 句柄以减少 NameNode RPC，并传递 Delete File 统计信息用于扫描裁剪；Lance 向量检索转向多 BE 分布式执行，同时保留全局 Top-K。Paimon、Iceberg 与 Lance 的读写路径正逐步具备完整支持。
landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.summar.description: Paimon 2.0 transactional writes close the external-table write gap; Iceberg HDFS handles open lazily to cut NameNode RPCs and propagate delete-file stats for scan pruning; Lance vector search moves to multi-BE distributed execution while preserving global Top-K. Read and write paths across Paimon, Iceberg, and Lance are becoming first-class.

landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.summar.message: VARIANT V2 成为默认 Shredded 路径
landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.summar.description: Variant V2 becomes the default shredded path

landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.summar.message: VARIANT V2 导入移除子列间重复的元数据解码和类型推断；原生 Shredded 执行在 BE 保留有类型的子列，避免强制折叠；默认开启的开关将规划和存储自动路由至 V2，同时提升 JSON 与半结构化工作负载的开箱性能及类型保真度。
landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.summar.description: Variant V2 ingestion removes redundant metadata decoding and type inference across children; native shredded execution preserves typed sub-columns on the BE without forced collapse; a default-on switch routes planning and storage to V2 automatically. Out-of-the-box performance and type fidelity for JSON and semi-structured workloads advance together.

landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.repos..message: 存算分离本周扩展对象存储覆盖并加固云模式 BE：新增 S3 Express One Zone，以及基于 GKE Workload Identity 的免密钥 GCS Vault；Rowset 之前的 Delete Bitmap 清理改用逐点删除，缓解 FDB 压力；其他修复覆盖 ARM64 正确性和 K8s BE 注册失败等问题。

landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.repos..message: Agent 可观测性本周强化 VARIANT 与倒排索引搜索的正确性。类型路径 Bloom Filter 回归、扩展的 VARIANT V1/V2 Segment 基准，以及针对评分 TopN 中已删除文档和额外谓词的修复，让基于半结构化与全文数据的 AI/Agent 查询行为更可靠、性能测量更易复现。

A typed-path Bloom Filter regression, expanded Variant V1/V2 segment benchmarks, and fixes for deleted documents and extra predicates in score TopN give AI/agent query paths on semi-structured and full-text data more reliable behavior and reproducible measurement.

landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.repos..message: Agent 可观测性继续加固 Routine Load JSON 语义和倒排索引内部实现。一条工作线让 JSON 导入依据基表 Schema 自动补齐未指定列，使导入更清晰；另一条工作线移除子读取器中误用的全局 NULL Bitmap，并梳理不同分析器代际下的 SNII 评分与缓存键。
landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.repos..description: Agent observability work is hardening Routine Load JSON semantics and inverted-index internals. landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.repos..message: 生态集成补齐 Spark/Hive、ADBC 和 Arrow Flight SQL 的语义缺口。新的 stack 表函数与 Spark/Hive 输出保持一致；ADBC 正确物化 ListView 变体；Flight SQL 将 DATETIME 暴露为不带时区的时间戳，使 Doris 在跨引擎、跨客户端交换数据时保留更准确的语义。
landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.repos..description: Ecosystem integration work fills gaps with Spark/Hive, ADBC, and Arrow Flight SQL. The new stack table function matches Spark/Hive output semantics, ADBC now materializes ListView variants correctly, and Flight SQL exposes DATETIME as timezone-naive timestamps. Doris now exchanges data across engines and clients with more faithful semantics.

landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.repos..message: 安全与治理强化日志脱敏：隐藏 HTTP 认证和 Stream Load 诊断路径中的明文凭证；对 information_schema.encryption_keys 的 IV/CIPHER 列，以及 backend_configuration 中的 tls_private_key_password 同样脱敏；新增 ldap_allow_empty_pass 设置以阻止 LDAP 空密码登录，显著降低默认权限下的敏感数据暴露。

landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.repos..description: Security and governance work closes a credential-exposure gap in config exports: after the BE side began masking the TLS private-key password, the same FE config key remained unmasked and is now redacted in Config.java so ADMIN SHOW FRONTEND CONFIG no longer returns the plaintext secret.

landing.reports.2026-08-17.report.repos..description: Kernel engineering this week advances execution-stack refactors and build hygiene in parallel. ReadSchema unifies column contracts across storage readers, row-binlog derivation moves into the block-transform chain, and BE cold builds shrink via PCH slimming, olap_common.h decoupling, and dwarf-5 line-tables debug info, with DORIS_DEV_DEBUG_INFO locking in compile-time guardrails at configure time.

landing.reports.2026-08-24.report.summar.message: 本周 Doris 保持强劲迭代，共合并 91 个 PR，51 位贡献者参与，新增 33 个 Issue，工作重点集中在内核工程、实时数仓和云原生。亮点体现出对底层优化的协同深入：端到端 TLS、提前聚合下推、进入扫描器与 Segment 的 Runtime Filter，以及 Iceberg/VARIANT 元数据统一；云模式按列压缩和单 Rowset 合并则进一步改善存算分离下的成本与效率。Doris 正稳步从实时分析引擎演进为统一、多模态、安全且适应云环境的数据平台。
landing.reports.2026-08-24.report.summar.description: Doris maintained strong momentum this week with 91 merged PRs, 51 contributors, and 33 new issues, with effort concentrated across kernel engineering, real-time warehousing, and cloud-native themes. The highlights signal a coordinated push into depth-first optimization—end-to-end TLS, eager aggregation pushdown, runtime filters reaching scanners and segments, and Iceberg/Variant metadata unification—while cloud-mode per-column compression and single-rowset compaction further strengthen cost and efficiency under storage-compute separation. Taken together, Doris is steadily evolving from a real-time analytics engine into a unified, multi-modal, secure, and cloud-ready data platform.

landing.reports.2026-08-24.report.summar.description: Doris unified TLS across internal paths this week: a target-aware HTTP client selects encrypted transport, BRPC gains custom cert-verify callbacks and runtime cert hot-reload, Cloud modules expose TLS hooks for FoundationDB and outbound clients, and CDC now honors internal HTTPS. The cluster moves toward end-to-end encryption by default, easing deployments

landing.reports.2026-08-24.report.summar.message: 提前聚合下推成为优化器的正式能力
landing.reports.2026-08-24.report.summar.description: Eager aggregation pushdown becoming a first-class optimizer

landing.reports.2026-08-24.report.summar.message: 提前聚合下推持续完善：基于统计信息决定何时下推 Distinct 聚合；贪心 JOIN 重排保持最佳下推位置；重写规则扩展至内部聚合。对于实时数仓，大量使用 Distinct 和多表 JOIN 的查询能够获得更稳定的计划和更低延迟。
landing.reports.2026-08-24.report.summar.description: Eager aggregation pushdown matures into a first-class optimizer: statistics decide when distinct aggregates are pushed down, greedy join reorder keeps the pushdown point optimal, and the rewrite extends coverage across inner aggregates. For real-time warehouses, plans stabilize and latency drops on distinct-heavy and multi-join queries.

landing.reports.2026-08-24.report.summar.message: Runtime Filter 深入扫描器与 Segment
landing.reports.2026-08-24.report.summar.description: Runtime filters reach scanners and segments

landing.reports.2026-08-24.report.summar.message: Runtime Filter 向更底层推进：FE 增加适用性元数据，让单列 HASH 目标能够按桶裁剪，跳过整个扫描器；BE 将迟到的过滤器下推至 Segment Iterator，裁剪 Segment、Page 与 Row Group，减少实时数仓星型 JOIN 的扫描量和 IO 放大。
landing.reports.2026-08-24.report.summar.description: Runtime filters go deeper: FE adds eligibility metadata so single-column HASH targets can prune at the bucket level, skipping whole scanners, while the BE pushes late-arriving filters into segment iterators to prune segments, pages, and row groups. Star-join queries on real-time warehouses see less scanning and I/O amplification.

landing.reports.2026-08-24.report.summar.message: Doris 统一 FE 外部元数据缓存框架，消除重复封装和临时失效逻辑；Iceberg 未 Shred 的 VARIANT 在执行 `element_at` 时避免完整物化根节点；Lance Catalog 新增原生 OSS 存储，为湖仓用户提供更一致的元数据和更快的跨格式查询。
landing.reports.2026-08-24.report.summar.description: Doris unifies the FE external-metadata cache framework to remove duplicated wrappers and ad-hoc invalidations, speeds up `element_at` on Iceberg unshredded Variant by avoiding full root materialization, and adds native OSS storage to the Lance catalog. Lakehouse users gain consistent metadata and faster cross-format queries.

landing.reports.2026-08-24.report.summar.message: 云模式从两方面提高存储效率：表可以逐列设置压缩方式，让冷热数据、文本和数值列使用不同编码器，降低存储占用和扫描带宽；导入时可在单 Rowset 内执行分组合并，缓解包含大量 Segment 的 Rowset 带来的内存压力，进一步提升存算分离效率。
landing.reports.2026-08-24.report.summar.description: Cloud-mode Doris tightens storage efficiency on both axes: tables can set compression per column, so hot vs. cold and text vs. numeric fields use different codecs to cut footprint and scan bandwidth, and loads now run grouped compaction inside a single rowset to cut memory pressure on segment-heavy rowsets. landing.reports.2026-08-31.report.repos..description: Compute-storage separation work is stabilizing the cloud control plane, caches, and scheduler. Ranger row-filter and data-mask requests switched to the service-specific select access type so authorization no longer breaks

landing.reports.2026-09-07.report.summar.message: 本周 Doris 社区保持活跃，共合并 136 个 PR，48 位贡献者参与。能力建设明确聚焦实时数仓和内核工程：Arrow Flight SQL 升级为正式前端协议、VARIANT 成为默认半结构化列类型，以及列与列谓词的 ZoneMap 裁剪，体现出对查询性能和现代数据接口的深入投入。存算分离、云原生、多模态湖仓和安全治理等方向也稳步推进，整体从核心引擎向更紧密协同的生态扩展。
landing.reports.2026-09-07.report.summar.description: Doris maintained strong momentum this week, with 136 merged PRs and 48 contributors underscoring an active community. The capability lines point clearly toward real-time data warehousing and kernel engineering, marked by breakthroughs such as Arrow Flight SQL promoted to a first-class front end, Variant as the default semi-structured column type, and Zone Map pruning for column-vs-column predicates—together signaling deeper investment in query performance and modern data interfaces. Meanwhile, mid-tail areas including cloud-native separation, multi-modal lakehouse, and security & governance advanced steadily, painting a clear trajectory from the core engine outward into a more cohesive ecosystem.

landing.reports.2026-09-07.report.summar.description: Doris is elevating Arrow Flight SQL to sit alongside MySQL as an equal front end: a shared session layer, unified result encoding and quotas, a complete Flight SQL feature set, plus a maintained official `doris` driver in the ADBC Foundry so a single URI connects straight to the lakehouse.

landing.reports.2026-09-07.report.summar.message: VARIANT V2 替代旧路径成为默认列类型，并接入等值 JOIN、排序等关系运算；未 Shred 的 Parquet VARIANT 提取也得到加速，使 Doris 中的半结构化数据更易使用、更便于关联、执行更高效。
landing.reports.2026-09-07.report.summar.description: Variant V2 replaces the legacy path as the default column type, with relational ops like equality joins and ordering now wired through; unshredded Parquet Variant extraction also speeds up, making semi-structured data more usable, joinable, and efficient in Doris.

landing.reports.2026-09-07.report.summar.description: Zone map pruning expands beyond column-vs-constant to column-vs-column, backed by a unified interface for predicates and expressions to read zone maps, so self-joins and correlated subqueries can now skip irrelevant segments and row groups for leaner queries.

landing.reports.2026-09-07.report.summar.message: Ranger 授权通过插件 SPI 从 fe-core 中抽离；兼容 MySQL 的双密码、持久化 ACCOUNT_LOCK、受约束的 SU 代理认证，以及 AI Resource 仅 root 可管理等能力，使凭证轮换、账户锁定和多租户代理更安全、更可控。
landing.reports.2026-09-07.report.summar.description: Ranger authorization is extracted into a plugin SPI out of fe-core; MySQL-compatible dual passwords, durable ACCOUNT_LOCK, constrained SU proxy auth, and root-only protection of AI resources make credential rotation, account locking, and multi-tenant proxying safer and more controllable.

landing.reports.2026-09-07.report.repos..message: 安全与治理收紧行策略和点查授权。新工作将行策略应用于外部 Catalog 上的 View，阻止 LEADING Hint 绕过，在写时合并时间旅行中强制执行策略；CDC 操作以流式任务创建者身份运行；复用预处理点查前重新验证安全权限，并要求使用固定 Key 谓词。
landing.reports.2026-09-07.report.repos..description: Security and governance is tightening row-policy and point-query authorization. New work applies row policies to views over external catalogs, blocks LEADING-hint bypasses, enforces policies on merge-on-write time travel, runs CDC operations as the streaming job creator, revalidates security before reusing a prepared point query, and enforces fixed key predicates there;

landing.reports.2026-09-07.report.repos..message: 内核与工程覆盖解析器、优化器、存储和工具链清理。重点包括大小写不敏感 Lexer 快速路径、合并 SegmentWriter 与 VerticalSegmentWriter、移除 CommonGrams 并重新对齐 SNII 磁盘格式；同时修复聚合重写、View DDL 转义、Parquet 时间戳和浮点转宽整数等正确性问题，推进与协议无关的会话和执行层，包括 ProtocolAdapter、ResultSender 与 Arrow 相关能力。
landing.reports.2026-09-07.report.repos..description: Kernel & engineering covers parser, optimizer, storage and toolchain cleanups. Highlights: case-insensitive lexer fast paths, a merged SegmentWriter/VerticalSegmentWriter, removal of CommonGrams with the SNII on-disk format realigned, and correctness fixes across aggregate rewrites, view DDL escaping, Parquet timestamps and float-to-wide-integer casts. Meanwhile the protocol-agnostic session/execution layer advances (ProtocolAdapter, ResultSender, Arrow

landing.reports.2026-09-07.report.repos..message: 内核工程覆盖存储、类型、规划器、导入与 ARM 正确性，纳秒精度 TIMEV2 是重点功能。新工作校验 AggState 参数，在 CREATE TABLE LIKE 中保留生成列会话信息，对齐 Hash Join 的带符号零和 NaN 处理，修复递归 CTE Fragment，移除浮点 ZoneMap 中无 NaN 的假设，并完善暂停查询行为。
landing.reports.2026-09-07.report.repos..description: Kernel engineering spans storage, types, the planner, loads, and ARM correctness, with nanosecond-precision TIMEV2 as a key feature. landing.reports.2026-10-05.report.repos..description: Real-time warehouses need reliable change consumption and bounded log retention. ROW Binlog gained TTL filtering and automatic expired-log cleanup on idle tables across shared-nothing and cloud deployments, preserving source data and version continuity. Supporting work strengthened ingestion, Stream validation, and commit timestamps while reducing unrelated schema changes’ impact on materialized views.

landing.userStory.AWS.message: Amazon Web Services（AWS）是领先的云计算平台，提供多种可扩展、可靠的云服务。基于 Apache Doris 的商业产品 VeloDB Cloud 可在 AWS 上使用，提供可扩展、高效的数据分析能力。
